docs.title: Clothing
docs.text: Clothing is what a character wears over or in place of armor.

docs.title: Wearing Clothing
docs.text:
Basic clothing is typically a complete set of clothes, but individual pieces of clothing can be infused with magic effects.

Type Worn Limit Crafting Tool Boots On feet 1 pair Cobbler's Tools Belt Around waist 1 Leatherworker's Tools Bracers On forearms 1 pair Leatherworker's Tools or Smith's Tools Cloak On shoulders 1 Leatherworker's Tools or Weaver's Tools Clothes On body 1 set Weaver's Tools Gloves On hands 1 pair Leatherworker's Tools Hat On head 1 Leatherworker's Tools or Weaver's Tools Jewelry Varies — Glassblower's Tools, Jeweler's Tools, or Tinker's Tools

docs.title: Costume
docs.text:
Clothing (Clothes), 5 gold

While wearing a Costume, you gain Advantage on any Ability Check you make to impersonate the person or type of person it represents.

docs.title: Fine Clothes
docs.text:
Clothing (Clothes), 15 gold

Fine Clothes are made of expensive fabrics and adorned with expertly crafted details. Some events and locations admit only people wearing Fine Clothes.

docs.title: Robe
docs.text:
Clothing (Clothes), 1 gold

A Robe has vocational or ceremonial significance. Some events and locations admit only people wearing a Robe bearing certain colors or symbols.

docs.title: Traveler's Clothes
docs.text:
Clothing (Clothes), 2 gold

Traveler's Clothes are resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.

docs.title: Combat Gear
docs.text: Combat Gear is anything made to be used in a fight other than standard weapons.

docs.title: Ammunition
docs.text:
Ammunition, Value varies

Weapons with the Ammunition property require Ammunition to make an attack and specify which type in their description. Each type requires different storage, which must be bought separately.

Individual pieces of Ammunition are Consumable. Ammunition is usually crafted in batches that fit into their corresponding storage container.

Type Weapon Storage Qty. Value Arrow Bow Quiver 20 1 gold Bolt Crossbow Bolt Case 20 1 gold Bullet Firearm Pouch 10 3 gold Sling Stone Sling Pouch 20 4 copper

docs.title: Ball Bearings
docs.text:
Other, 1 gold

Ball Bearings come in a Pouch.

docs.title: Scatter
docs.text:
Utilize Action: You can spill the Ball Bearings from a Pouch, covering a level, 10-foot Square area within 10 feet.

After a creature enters this area, the creature makes a Reflex Save (DC 10).

Fail The target is knocked Prone. Success No effect.

It takes 10 minutes to recover spilled Ball Bearings.

docs.title: Caltrops
docs.text:
Other, 1 gold

Caltrops come in a Pouch.

docs.title: Scatter
docs.text:
Utilize Action: You can spread the Caltrops from a Pouch, covering a level, 5-foot Square area within Reach.

After a creature enters this area, the creature makes a Reflex Save (DC 15).

Fail The target takes 1 Piercing Damage. The target is Immobile until the start of its next Turn. Success No effect.

It takes 10 minutes to recover spread Caltrops.

docs.title: Healer's Kit
docs.text: Other, Consumable, 5 gold

docs.title: Stabilize
docs.text: Utilize Action; 10 uses: You can stabilize a Downed creature within Reach.

docs.title: Hunting Trap
docs.text: Other, 2 gold

docs.title: Set
docs.text:
Utilize Action: You can set the Hunting Trap, affixing it by a heavy Chain to an Anchored object within Reach.

The first creature that steps on the set Hunting Trap makes a Reflex Save (DC 13).

Fail The target takes 1d4 Piercing Damage. The trap attaches to the target. The target is Immobile until the start of its next Turn. Success No effect.

While the Hunting Trap is attached to a creature, the creature's movement is limited by the length of the Chain (typically 3 feet).

docs.title: Remove
docs.text:
Any creature that can reach an attached trap can take this Action.

Utilize Action: The creature makes an Athletics Check (DC 13).

Success The Hunting Trap is removed. Fail The trap deals 1 Piercing Damage to the attached creature.

docs.title: Net
docs.text: Other, 1 gold

docs.title: Ensnare
docs.text:
A Net can be wielded as a Simple Melee Weapon with Thrown (15 feet).

Hit You deal no damage. If the target is Large or smaller, until the target escapes or the Net is destroyed, the target is Restrained.

docs.title: Escape
docs.text:
Any Restrained creature can take this Action.

Utilize Action: The creature makes an Athletics Check (DC 10).

Success The creature escapes.

docs.title: Durability
docs.text: The Net has Armor Class 10, Hit Points 5, and Bludgeoning Immunity. If it drops to 0 Hit Points, it is destroyed.

docs.title: Restorative Ointment
docs.text: Potion, Consumable, 200 gold

docs.title: Apply
docs.text: Utilize Action; 5 uses: You can heal a creature within Reach by 2d8 + 2 and end 1 Sickness on it.

docs.title: Containers
docs.text: Containers are items used to store and carry other items.

docs.title: Backpack
docs.text:
Container, 2 gold

A Backpack holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot.

docs.title: Barrel
docs.text:
Container, 2 gold

A Barrel holds up to 40 gallons of liquid or up to 4 cubic feet of dry goods.

docs.title: Basket
docs.text:
Container, 4 silver

A Basket holds up to 40 pounds within 2 cubic feet.

docs.title: Bolt Case
docs.text:
Container, 1 gold

A Bolt Case holds up to 20 Bolts.

docs.title: Bucket
docs.text:
Container, 5 copper

A Bucket holds up to half a cubic foot of contents.

docs.title: Chest
docs.text:
Container, 5 gold

A Chest holds up to 12 cubic feet of contents.

docs.title: Flask
docs.text:
Container, 2 copper

A Flask holds up to 1 pint of liquid.

docs.title: Glass Bottle
docs.text:
Container, 2 gold

A Glass Bottle holds up to one and a half pints of liquid.

docs.title: Iron Pot
docs.text:
Container, 2 gold

An Iron Pot holds up to 1 gallon of liquid.

docs.title: Jug
docs.text:
Container, 2 copper

A Jug holds up to 1 gallon of liquid.

docs.title: Map or Scroll Case
docs.text:
Container, 1 gold

A Map or Scroll Case holds up to 10 sheets of Paper or 5 sheets of Parchment.

docs.title: Pouch
docs.text:
Container, 5 silver

A Pouch holds up to 6 pounds within one-fifth of a cubic foot.

docs.title: Quiver
docs.text:
Container, 1 gold

A Quiver holds up to 20 Arrows.

docs.title: Sack
docs.text:
Container, 1 copper

A Sack holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot.

docs.title: Vial
docs.text:
Container, 1 gold

A Vial holds up to 4 ounces of liquid.

docs.title: Waterskin
docs.text:
Container, 2 silver

A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints of liquid.

docs.title: Light Sources
docs.text: Light Sources are items that help with seeing without the use of special senses.

docs.title: Bullseye Lantern
docs.text:
Other, 10 gold

A Bullseye Lantern burns Oil as fuel. While lit, a Bullseye Lantern emits a 60-foot Cone of Bright Light and Dim Light 60 feet further.

docs.title: Candle
docs.text:
Other, Consumable, 1 copper

While lit, a Candle emits Bright Light out to 5 feet and Dim Light 5 feet further, and burns for 1 hour.

docs.title: Light
docs.text: Utilize Action: You can light or snuff out this candle, deducting the time it burned in increments of 1 minute.

docs.title: Hooded Lantern
docs.text:
Other, 5 gold

A Hooded Lantern burns Oil as fuel. While lit, a Hooded Lantern emits Bright Light out to 30 feet and Dim Light 30 feet further.

docs.title: Adjust Hood
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can lower or raise the hood. While lowered, the light is restricted to Bright Light out to 5 feet and Dim Light 5 feet further.

docs.title: Lamp
docs.text:
Other, 5 silver

A Lamp burns Oil as fuel. While lit, a Lamp emits Bright Light out to 15 feet and Dim Light 30 feet further.

docs.title: Tinderbox
docs.text:
Other, 5 silver

A Tinderbox is a small container holding flint, fire, steel, and tinder used to kindle a fire.

docs.title: Ignite
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can light a Candle, Lamp, Lantern, or Torch — or anything else with exposed fuel.

docs.title: Torch
docs.text:
Other, Consumable, 1 copper

While lit, a Torch burns for 1 hour and emits Bright Light out to 20 feet and Dim Light 20 feet further.

docs.title: Throw
docs.text:
A lit Torch can be wielded as a Simple Melee Weapon with Thrown (15 feet).

Hit You deal 1 Fire Damage.

docs.title: Crafting Materials
docs.text: Materials are special substances that pass their qualities on to whatever is crafted from them.

docs.title: Adamantine
docs.text:
Material (Metal), Consumable, 500 gold

Adamantine objects weigh 50% more than normal, and gain Immunity to Physical damage from non-Adamantine sources (this Immunity doesn't protect the item's wielder).

docs.title: Armor
docs.text: You are unaffected by Critical Hits from non-Adamantine sources (Critical Hits gain no effects, and the Attack Roll must beat your Armor Class to hit you).

docs.title: Weapon
docs.text: Attacks with this weapon against objects are Critical Hits.

docs.title: Heartwood
docs.text:
Material (Wood), Consumable, 1,000 gold

Heartwood naturally mends normal wear and tear, can be a Spellcasting Focus for any Spell, and can be used to create items normally made of metal.

docs.title: Weapon
docs.text: This weapon's Physical Attack Masterwork bonus is also its Spell Attack Masterwork bonus.

docs.title: Ironwill
docs.text:
Material (Metal), Consumable, 2,500 gold

You can use this item as a Spellcasting Focus for any Spell.

docs.title: Armor
docs.text: You can use your Spellcasting Ability to make Fortitude saves, instead of Constitution.

docs.title: Weapon
docs.text: You can use your Spellcasting Ability to make Physical Attacks with this weapon, instead of Strength or Dexterity.

docs.title: Mithral
docs.text:
Material (Metal), Consumable, 500 gold

This item weighs 50% less than normal.

docs.title: Armor
docs.text: This Armor doesn't have a Strength requirement or Stealth penalty.

docs.title: Weapon
docs.text: If this weapon is Light, it gains the Finesse property. If this weapon is not Light or Heavy, it becomes Light.

docs.title: Quicksilver
docs.text:
Material (Metal), Consumable, 500 gold

Quicksilver is impractical for making items other than Armor and Weapons.

docs.title: Armor
docs.text:
Utilize Action

You can don or doff this Armor.

docs.title: Weapon
docs.text:
Bonus Action

You can change this weapon into the form of any Melee Weapon.

docs.title: Silver
docs.text:
Material (Metal), Consumable, 100 gold

Silver can't be used to make Weapons or Armor, but Weapons and Armor can be alchemically coated with it (a coated item keeps its normal Material's effects as well).

docs.title: Weapon
docs.text: This weapon's Attacks against a shapeshifted creature deal 1 additional Damage Die.

docs.title: Potions
docs.text: A Potion is a fluid with special properties.

docs.title: Delivery
docs.text:
A Potion has a single effect, which it applies to the target — whatever a delivery method brings it into contact with. Its delivery types determine which methods carry that effect intact.

Delivery The target is… Ingested a creature that swallows the potion Contact anything the potion touches Injury a creature damaged by a weapon coated with the potion

A sealed container doesn't expose you to a potion — only spilling, breaking, or splashing it does. Carrying a Vial of Alchemist's Fire is safe; dropping it isn't.

A potion may support several deliveries, or none. A potion with no delivery type is used only through an action on its own card.

docs.title: Administer
docs.text: Bonus Action or Utilize Action: You can administer an Ingested potion to a target — yourself, an Ally within Reach, or an Incapacitated or Restrained creature within Reach. If you Utilize, any dice the potion rolls to determine its effect are maximized.

docs.title: Throw
docs.text:
A glass container filled with a Contact or Injury potion can be wielded as a Simple Melee Weapon with Thrown (20/60 feet).

Hit You deal 1 Piercing Damage, and the potion affects the target and the space it occupies.

After the Attack, the container and its contents are destroyed. A potion delivered this way doesn't cut as deep as a coated weapon, so the target gains Advantage on Saving Throws against an Injury potion's effects.

docs.title: Pour
docs.text: Utilize Action: You can pour a Contact potion across a 10-foot Square within Reach, targeting the area rather than the creatures standing in it. The container isn't destroyed.

docs.title: Coat Weapon
docs.text: Bonus Action; 1 Injury Potion: You can coat 1 weapon that deals Piercing or Slashing Damage, or up to 3 pieces of ammunition. Once applied, the potion retains potency for 1 minute or until it strikes a creature, whichever comes first.

docs.title: Acid
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested, Contact, Injury), Consumable, 25 gold

This potion deals 2d6 Acid Damage to the target.

docs.title: Alchemist's Fire
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested, Contact, Injury), Consumable, 50 gold

This potion burns (1d4) the target and deals 1d4 Fire Damage to it.

docs.title: Antitoxin
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 50 gold

The target's Saving Throws against being Sickened increase by 5 for 1 hour.

docs.title: Basic Poison
docs.text:
Potion (Injury), Consumable, 100 gold

This potion deals 1d4 Poison Damage to the target.

docs.title: Elixir of Health
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 2,000 gold

Each Blindness, Deafness, Paralysis, and Sickness on the target ends.

docs.title: Holy Water
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested, Contact, Injury), Consumable, 25 gold

This potion deals 2d8 Radiant Damage to the target if it is a Fiend or Undead.

docs.title: Oil of Etherealness
docs.text:
Potion (Contact), Consumable, 2,000 gold

This potion has no effect unless it is applied.

docs.title: Apply
docs.text:
10 minutes: You can apply this oil to a creature within Reach. The target gains the effect of Etherealness for 1 hour.

One vial coats a Medium or smaller creature and its equipment; each Size above Medium needs another vial.

docs.title: Oil of Sharpness
docs.text:
Potion (Contact), Consumable, 20,000 gold

This potion has no effect unless it is applied.

docs.title: Apply
docs.text: 1 minute: You can apply this oil to a nonmagical Melee weapon that deals Piercing or Slashing Damage, or to twenty pieces of nonmagical ammunition, within Reach. The target's Physical Masterwork bonus becomes +3 for 1 hour.

docs.title: Oil of Slipperiness
docs.text:
Potion (Contact), Consumable, 200 gold

This potion gives the target the effect of Grease for 8 hours.

docs.title: Apply
docs.text:
10 minutes: You can apply this oil to a creature within Reach. The target gains the effect of Freedom of Movement for 8 hours.

One vial coats a Medium or smaller creature and its equipment; each Size above Medium needs another vial.

docs.title: Oil
docs.text:
Potion (Contact), Consumable, 1 silver

This potion covers the target in Oil for 1 minute. A target covered in Oil takes an additional 5 damage from any Fire Damage dealt to it.

docs.title: Fuel
docs.text: Utilize Action: You can light or extinguish Oil in a Lamp or Lantern. Oil in a Lamp or Lantern burns for a total of 6 hours before being consumed.

docs.title: Perfume of Bewitching
docs.text:
Potion (Contact), Consumable, 50 gold

The target gains Advantage on Deception and Persuasion Checks against Humanoids within 5 feet for 1 hour.

docs.title: Perfume
docs.text:
Potion (Contact), Consumable, 5 gold

The target gains Advantage on Persuasion Checks against Independent Humanoids within 5 feet for 1 hour.

docs.title: Philter of Love
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 200 gold

The target is Charmed for 1 hour by the first creature it sees within 10 minutes.

docs.title: Potion of Animal Friendship
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 200 gold

The target casts Animal Friendship as a 3rd-Level Spell without components (DC 13).

docs.title: Potion of Clairvoyance
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 2,000 gold

The target gains the effect of Clairvoyance for 10 minutes (no Concentration required).

docs.title: Potion of Climbing
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 50 gold

The target gains a Climb Speed equal to its Speed for 1 hour.

docs.title: Potion of Comprehension
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 50 gold

The target gains the effect of Comprehend Languages for 1 hour.

docs.title: Potion of Diminution
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 2,000 gold

The target gains the Reduce effect of Enlarge/Reduce for 1d4 hours (no Concentration required).

docs.title: Potion of Fire Breath
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 200 gold

The target gains the following Action for 1 hour.

docs.title: Breathe Fire
docs.text:
Bonus Action; 3 uses: You can exhale fire at one creature within 30 feet. That creature makes a Reflex Save (DC 13).

Fail You deal 4d6 Fire Damage to the target. Success You deal half as much damage.

docs.title: Potion of Flying
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 20,000 gold

The target gains the effect of Fly for 1 hour (no Concentration required).

docs.title: Potion of Gaseous Form
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 2,000 gold

The target gains the effect of Gaseous Form for 1 hour (no Concentration required).

docs.title: Disperse
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can end this effect.

docs.title: Potion of Giant Strength
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, Value Varies

Each Potion of Giant Strength has a type of Giant, which determines this item's Strength and Value.

Giant Strength Value Hill 5 200 gold Stone 6 2,000 gold Frost 6 2,000 gold Fire 7 10,000 gold Cloud 8 20,000 gold Storm 9 100,000 gold

The target's Strength becomes the potion's Strength for 1 hour, unless its Strength is already that high.

docs.title: Potion of Greater Healing
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 200 gold

The target heals by 4d4 + 4.

docs.title: Potion of Greater Invisibility
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 20,000 gold

The target gains the effect of Greater Invisibility for 1 hour (no Concentration required).

docs.title: Potion of Growth
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 200 gold

The target gains the Enlarge effect of Enlarge/Reduce for 10 minutes (no Concentration required).

docs.title: Potion of Healing
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 50 gold

The target heals by 2d4 + 2.

docs.title: Potion of Heroism
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 2,000 gold

The target gains 10 Temporary Hit Points and the effect of Bless for 1 hour (no Concentration required).

docs.title: Potion of Lesser Invisibility
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 2,000 gold

The target gains the effect of Lesser Invisibility for 1 hour (no Concentration required).

docs.title: Potion of Invulnerability
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 2,000 gold

The target gains Resistance to all damage for 1 minute.

docs.title: Potion of Longevity
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 20,000 gold

The target's age decreases by 1d6 + 6 years, to a minimum of 13 years.

Each Potion of Longevity you consume after the first has a cumulative 10% chance to increase your age by 1d6 + 6 years instead.

docs.title: Potion of Mind Reading
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 2,000 gold

The target gains the effect of Detect Thoughts (DC 15) for 10 minutes (no Concentration required).

docs.title: Potion of Poison
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 200 gold

This poison looks, smells, and tastes like a beneficial Potion, though Identify reveals its true nature.

This potion deals 4d6 Poison Damage to the target. The target makes a Fortitude Save (DC 13).

Fail The potion sickens the target for 1 hour. Success No effect.

docs.title: Potion of Pugilism
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 200 gold

The target's Unarmed Strikes deal an additional 1d6 Force Damage for 10 minutes.

docs.title: Potion of Resistance
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 200 gold

Each Potion of Resistance has an Elemental or Esoteric Damage Type.

The target gains Resistance to its Damage Type for 1 hour.

docs.title: Potion of Speed
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 20,000 gold

The target gains the effect of Haste for 1 minute (no Concentration required), and doesn't become Incapacitated after it ends.

docs.title: Potion of Superior Healing
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 2,000 gold

The target heals by 8d4 + 8.

docs.title: Potion of Supreme Healing
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 20,000 gold

The target heals by 10d4 + 20.

docs.title: Potion of Vitality
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 20,000 gold

The target's Exhaustion levels are removed, and each Sickness on it ends. Each Hit Die the target spends heals it by the maximum amount for 24 hours.

docs.title: Potion of Water Breathing
docs.text:
Potion (Ingested), Consumable, 200 gold

The target gains the effect of Water Breathing for 24 hours.

docs.title: Scroll
docs.text: A Scroll is a paper that usually contains a consumable magical effect. Once used, a scroll crumbles to dust.

docs.title: Scroll of Protection
docs.text:
Scroll, Consumable, 2,000 gold

Each Scroll of Protection has a Creature Type.

docs.title: Read
docs.text: Magic Action: You can read the scroll, creating a 5-foot Aura for 5 minutes. Creatures of the scroll's Creature Type can't enter the Aura or affect anything inside it. After you move so that such a creature would be inside the Aura, this effect ends.

docs.title: Overcome
docs.text:
Any creature within 5 feet of the Aura can take this Action.

Magic Action: The creature makes a Will Save (DC 15). On a success, the Aura no longer affects it.

docs.title: Spell Scroll
docs.text:
Scroll, Consumable, Value Varies

This Scroll holds a single Spell. The Spell Level determines this item's Crafting Time and Value.

Spell Level Crafting Time Value Cantrip 1 day 50 gold 1st 1 day 200 gold 2nd 5 days 500 gold 3rd 10 days 2,000 gold 4th 40 days 20,000 gold 5th 60 days 50,000 gold 6th 120 days 100,000 gold

docs.title: Cast
docs.text:
If the scroll's Spell is on your Spell List, you can cast the Spell without Material components using the Spell's normal Casting Time. Then, the Scroll crumbles to dust.

Casting the Spell above the highest Spell Level you can normally cast requires an Ability Check using your Spellcasting Ability (DC 10 + Spell Level). On a failure, the Scroll crumbles to dust with no other effect.

docs.title: Copy
docs.text: A Wizard can make an Arcana Check (DC 10 + Spell Level). On a success, you copy a Wizard Spell from the Scroll into a spellbook. Whether the Check succeeds or fails, the Scroll is consumed.

docs.title: Spellcasting Focuses
docs.text: A Spellcasting Focus is used by a spellcaster to provide Material Components for Spells.

docs.title: Arcane Focus
docs.text:
Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus), Value varies

A Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard can use an Arcane Focus as a Spellcasting Focus.

Focus Value Crystal 10 gold Orb 20 gold Rod 10 gold Spellstaff 5 gold Wand 10 gold

docs.title: Component Pouch
docs.text:
Container (Pouch), 25 gold

A Component Pouch is watertight and filled with compartments that hold Material Components of your Spells.

docs.title: Druidic Focus
docs.text:
Spellcasting Focus (Druidic Focus), Value varies

A Druid or Ranger can use a Druidic Focus as a Spellcasting Focus.

Focus Value Sprig of Mistletoe 1 gold Staff 5 gold Yew Wand 10 gold

docs.title: Holy Symbol
docs.text:
Spellcasting Focus (Holy Symbol), Value varies

A Cleric or Paladin can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus.

Symbol Usage Value Amulet worn or held 5 gold Emblem on fabric or a Shield 5 gold Reliquary held 5 gold

docs.title: Survival Gear
docs.text: Survival Gear keeps you rested and healthy on long journeys.

docs.title: Bead of Nourishment
docs.text:
Other, Consumable, 50 gold

You can consume this bead and gain as much nourishment as 1 day of Rations.

docs.title: Bead of Refreshment
docs.text:
Other, Consumable, 50 gold

This bead dissolves in liquid, transforming up to a pint of it into drinking water. It can't affect magical liquids or poisons.

docs.title: Bedroll
docs.text:
Other, 1 gold

A Bedroll sleeps 1 Small or Medium creature. While in a Bedroll, you gain Immunity to Extreme Cold.

docs.title: Blanket
docs.text:
Other, 5 silver

While wrapped in a Blanket, you gain Protection from Extreme Cold.

docs.title: Rations
docs.text:
Other, Consumable, 5 silver

Rations consist of travel-ready food, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts.

docs.title: Tent
docs.text:
Other, 2 gold

A Tent sleeps up to 2 Small or Medium creatures.

docs.title: Tools
docs.text: Tools are specialized problem-solving implements.

docs.title: Bell
docs.text: Tool, 1 gold

docs.title: Ring
docs.text: Utilize Action: You can ring the Bell, producing a sound audible up to 60 feet away.

docs.title: Block and Tackle
docs.text:
Tool, 1 gold

A Block and Tackle allows you to hoist up to four times the weight you can normally lift.

docs.title: Chain
docs.text: Tool, 5 gold

docs.title: Bind
docs.text:
Utilize Action: You can choose an object or a Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained creature within Reach and make an Athletics Check (DC 13).

Success You wrap the Chain around the target. If the target's legs are bound, the target is Restrained.

docs.title: Escape
docs.text:
Any bound creature can take this Action.

Utilize Action: The creature makes an Acrobatics Check (DC 18).

Success The creature escapes.

docs.title: Break Free
docs.text:
Any creature that can reach a bound target can take this Action.

Utilize Action: The creature makes an Athletics Check (DC 20).

Success The Chain is destroyed.

docs.title: Climber's Kit
docs.text:
Tool, 25 gold

A Climber's Kit includes boot tips, gloves, pitons, and a harness.

docs.title: Belay
docs.text: Utilize Action: You can belay yourself to a surface within Reach. While belayed, you can't be moved more than 25 feet from the belay point.

docs.title: Unbelay
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can undo the belay.

docs.title: Crowbar
docs.text:
Tool, 2 gold

While using a Crowbar, your Strength Checks where its leverage can be applied increase by 5.

docs.title: Grappling Hook
docs.text: Tool, 2 gold

docs.title: Hook
docs.text:
Utilize Action: You can throw the Grappling Hook at a railing, ledge, or another fixture within 50 feet and make an Acrobatics Check (DC 13).

Success The hook catches on. If you tied a Rope to the hook, you can then Climb it.

docs.title: Iron Spikes
docs.text:
Tool, 1 gold

Iron Spikes come in bundles of 10.

docs.title: Drive
docs.text: Utilize Action: You can use a blunt object to hammer a Spike into wood, earth, or a similar material, jamming a door shut or anchoring a Rope or Chain you tie to the Spike.

docs.title: Ladder
docs.text:
Tool, 1 silver

A Ladder is 10 feet tall. You can Climb to move up or down it.

docs.title: Lock
docs.text:
Tool, 10 gold

A Lock comes with a key used to lock or unlock it.

docs.title: Pick Lock
docs.text:
Any creature without a key that can reach the Lock can take this Action.

Utilize Action: The creature makes a Precision Check (DC 20).

Success The creature chooses whether the Lock is locked or unlocked.

docs.title: Using Magic Items
docs.text:
Magic Items are ordinary gear powered by Infusions, magical properties beyond what mundane craftsmanship can achieve.

Magic Items usually require wearing or wielding them properly, just like normal items. Magic Items that don't fit the standard Item Types are called Wondrous Items, and their usage varies.

docs.title: Identification
docs.text:
Some Magic Items are indistinguishable from their nonmagical counterparts, while others are obviously magical.

  • Detect Magic is the fastest way to determine whether an item is infused with magic.
  • Identify is the fastest way to reveal an item's infused properties.
  • Wearing or attempting to use an item can offer hints about its magical nature. For Potions, a little taste is enough to tell you what a Potion does.
  • You can spend a Short Rest focused on only that item while in physical contact with it (this can't be the same Short Rest used to Attune to the item). After the Short Rest, you learn the item's properties and how to use them.

docs.title: Attunement
docs.text: Attunement is a special bond some Magic Items require before you can use their infused properties.

docs.title: Attunement Slots
docs.text: Each item you attune to occupies one of your Attunement Slots. You have 3 Attunement Slots. You must have a free slot to attune to another item.

docs.title: Harmonic Infusions
docs.text: A Harmonic infusion requires attunement, but doesn't occupy an Attunement Slot. When you attune to an item with multiple Harmonic and Attunement infusions, you attune and deattune to all of them at the same time.

docs.title: Becoming Attuned
docs.text: You can Attune to an item by spending a Short Rest focused on only that item while in physical contact with it (this can't be the same Short Rest used to identify the item). After the Short Rest, you become Attuned to the item and can use its full magical capabilities.

docs.title: Ending Attunement
docs.text:
You can voluntarily end Attunement by spending another Short Rest focused on the item. Your Attunement also ends if:

  • the item is more than 100 feet away from you for 24 hours.
  • another creature Attunes to the item.
  • you die.

docs.title: Charges
docs.text: An item with Charges lists its maximum number of Charges alongside how many it regains. Using certain effects expends a number of Charges, and an effect can't be used while the item lacks the Charges to pay for it.

docs.title: Regaining Charges
docs.text: An item regains Charges each Day, either a fixed number or a rolled amount noted in parentheses. An item never exceeds its maximum number of Charges.

docs.title: Command Words
docs.text: A Command Word is a word or phrase you must audibly speak aloud to use some of this item's effects, similar to a Spell's Verbal Component.

docs.title: Overlapping Infusions
docs.text:
You only gain the benefits of 1 Infusion with the same name at a time.

Some Infusions give each copy a quality of its own, such as an Ioun Stone's Type or an Item of Resistance's Damage Type. Each value of that quality counts as a separate Infusion, so an Item of Resistance (Cold) and an Item of Resistance (Fire) grant both Resistances.

docs.title: Cursed Items
docs.text:
Cursed items have a hidden, usually detrimental effect. Most methods of identifying an item don't reveal its curse.

Every Cursed item requires Attunement. You can't voluntarily end your Attunement to a Cursed item without Remove Curse or similar magic.

Cursed infusions can't be crafted, transferred, or removed without specific methods determined by your DM.

docs.title: Infusing Items
docs.text: Infusing is how a character weaves magic into an item. An item can have up to 2 Infusions at a time, and only 1 of them can require an Attunement Slot.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text: You can only infuse an item if you have Proficiency in Arcana and, if the Infusion casts or replicates any Spells, know those Spells each day you spend infusing the item.

docs.title: Time and Cost
docs.text:
The Cost of infusing an item is paid in raw materials and time based on the Infusion's Rarity. Consumable items require half as much time and gold.

Rarity Rank Time Cost Common 1 5 days 50 gold Uncommon 2 10 days 200 gold Rare 3 50 days 2,000 gold Very Rare 4 125 days 20,000 gold Legendary 5 250 days 100,000 gold

Every day of infusing requires 8 hours of work, but the total hours and days don't need to be consecutive.

docs.title: Working Together
docs.text: You can work with others to shorten the infusing time, provided each contributor has the appropriate Proficiencies and Spells. Each contributor reduces the total time as though they were working independently.

docs.title: Making Infusions Harmonic
docs.text: You can't remove an infusion's Attunement requirement, but you can reduce the number of Attunement Slots needed by making an infusion Harmonic. Making an Attunement item Harmonic increases its rarity by 1 Rank, and the time and cost required is based on the difference in its new rarity and old rarity.

docs.title: Removing Infusions
docs.text: You can permanently remove an Infusion from a Magic Item with 8 hours of work, provided you have Proficiency in Arcana and know Dispel Magic. Cursed and Artifact Infusions can't be removed without special methods unique to the item.

docs.title: Transferring Infusions
docs.text: You can transfer an Infusion to another appropriate item, provided you have Proficiency in Arcana. Doing so costs no gold and takes half the time a new Infusion of the same Rarity would take.

docs.text: Rarity Common Uncommon Rare Very Rare Legendary Artifact Unique Cursed

docs.title: Orrery of the Wanderer
docs.text:
Artifact Wondrous Item, Harmonic

A masterwork clockwork orrery that charts the planes and bends travel across them. Its power is split among six relic components, each a potent artifact in its own right.

This delicate and exquisitely crafted clockwork orrery features multiple geared components whose sweeping hands and dials represent the complex interplay of planar and magical realms. The main body is about 6 inches in diameter, and contains up to 6 additional components, individually powerful relics containing a portion of the orrery's power.

docs.title: Part of a Whole
docs.text: While a component is not installed in the completed chassis, Attuning to the component may have unpredictable side effects, as determined by the DM.

docs.title: Chassis
docs.text: This hollow, golden shell contains the framework necessary to connect the other components of the orrery.

docs.title: Some Assembly Required
docs.text: You can spend 1 hour to install or remove a component from the chassis, provided you have Proficiency in Tinker's Tools.

docs.title: Component Hub
docs.text:
While you are attuned to components installed in the chassis, 1 of them is Harmonic (you choose which).

While attuned to a component installed in the chassis, being away from the component doesn't end your attunement to it.

After you finish a Short Rest within 1 mile of the chassis, you can change your attunement to a different component that isn't attuned to another creature.

docs.title: Sentience
docs.text:
The chassis is a sentient item with 4 Intelligence, 4 Wisdom, and 0 Charisma. It has hearing and Darkvision out to 120 feet. Its alignment is Lawful Neutral.

The chassis knows all Standard Languages, Celestial, Deep Speech, and Gith, but communicates exclusively in Elvish using its Dimensional Radio.

docs.title: Belt of Pocket Monsters
docs.text:
Legendary Clothing (Belt), Attunement (Beast Master Ranger)

This exotic leather belt bears six talon-shaped claws, each gripping a 3-inch stone-grey ball. Each ball is divided into two hemispheres by a thin seam and hinge with a small button at its center. Only an attuned creature can attach or remove a ball from the belt.

docs.title: Linking Monsters
docs.text:
Each ball can house the spirit of a Beast or Monstrosity, which can be conjured as a Primal Companion (called a monster). A ball that remains more than 30 feet from the belt for 1 minute vanishes and reappears in its place on the belt.

After you attune to the belt, each of your Primal Companion forms becomes linked to a ball. While linked, a ball's color and pattern change to reflect the monster bound within it (you determine its appearance).

For each linked ball, reduce your daily Gotcha! uses by 1.

docs.title: Conjuring Monsters
docs.text:
Whenever you would conjure a Primal Companion or change its form, you can instead choose any monster linked to the belt.

All monsters linked to the belt share the same Hit Points, Attunement Slots, and equipment. After you conjure a monster:

  • It appears wearing any equipment worn by the previous monster.
  • Any equipment that can't be worn due to the new monster's anatomy falls to the ground at the monster's feet.
  • If the new monster's Hit Point Maximum is lower than the previous monster's current Hit Points, the new monster's Hit Points equal its Hit Point Maximum.

docs.title: Command Word
docs.text:
Magic Action: If you have a free hand, you can speak 1 of the following Command Words to use its effect.

Command I Choose You! You throw a linked ball up to 30 feet, conjuring its monster where the ball lands (or the nearest unoccupied space large enough to hold it). If you already have a monster conjured, it immediately returns to its ball (no action required). Return! Your conjured monster returns to its ball, along with anything it is wearing. Anything the monster was carrying falls to the ground in its previous space. Gotcha! 6 times per Day: You throw an unlinked ball at a Beast or Monstrosity within 30 feet. The target makes a Capture Save (DC Ranger Spell Save DC); on a failure, the creature's body vanishes and its spirit becomes bound to the thrown ball. Release! You release a linked monster. The creature's original body reappears within 5 feet, healed to its Hit Point Maximum. A released creature behaves according to its nature and can't be captured again by the belt.

docs.title: Capture Saves
docs.text: A Capture Save adds the creature's Level to the total instead of an Ability or Proficiency Bonus. The creature automatically succeeds unless it is Incapacitated, Downed, Stabilized, or an Ally, and gains Advantage on the Save if it has more than 0 Hit Points.

docs.title: Ending Attunement
docs.text:
After your attunement to the belt ends:

  • Your normal Primal Companion forms become unlinked from the belt.
  • If your currently conjured monster is not one of your normal Primal Companion forms, it vanishes and is replaced by a Primal Companion of your choice.

If the belt remains unattuned for 24 hours, all linked monsters are released as though by the Release! command.

Magic Action; Once per 7 Days: You can blow the horn, conjuring the listed number of Berserker Companions within 60 feet. They gain Charm Immunity and Fear Immunity, and disappear after 1 hour or after dropping to 0 Hit Points.

Without the horn's Proficiency, the Berserkers are Enemies that Attack you instead.

docs.title: Command
docs.text: Free Action: You can command the Berserkers to move and take any Action available to them.

docs.title: Horseshoes of Speed
docs.text:
Rare Wondrous Item

These horseshoes come in a set of 4. While all of them are affixed to the same creature, its Speed increases by 30 feet.

docs.title: Affix
docs.text: 1 minute: You can affix all 4 horseshoes to the hooves of a creature within Reach, or remove them.

docs.title: Instant Fortress
docs.text: Rare Wondrous Item, Attunement

docs.title: Raise Tower
docs.text:
Magic Action: You can place this statuette on the ground, growing it into an adamantine tower 20 feet on a side and 30 feet high, with arrow slits, a battlement, 2 floors, and a single door facing you. You can use this Action again to revert the tower, provided it is empty.

Everything in the tower's area is propelled to the nearest unoccupied space outside it.

The roof, door, and walls each have Armor Class 20, 100 Hit Points, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing Immunity except from siege equipment, and Resistance to all other damage. Reverting the tower doesn't repair it.

docs.title: Open Door
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can open or close the tower's door. It has Immunity to Knock and similar magic.

docs.title: Instrument of the Bards
docs.text:
Rare Wondrous Item (Musical Instrument), Attunement (Bard)

This instrument comes in several types, each named for a bard college. The college determines this item's rarity, Spell Save DC, and the Spells it can cast.

College Rarity DC Spells All — — Fly, Lesser Invisibility, Levitate, and Protection from Good and Evil Doss Lute Uncommon 13 Animal Friendship, Protection from Energy (Fire Damage only), and Protection from Poison Fochlucan Bandore Uncommon 13 Entangle, Faerie Fire, Shillelagh, and Speak with Animals Mac-Fuirmidh Cittern Uncommon 13 Barkskin, Cure Wounds, and Fog Cloud Canaith Mandolin Rare 15 Cure Wounds (3rd Level), Dispel Magic, and Protection from Energy (Lightning Damage only) Cli Lyre Rare 15 Stone Shape, Wall of Fire, and Wind Wall Anstruth Harp Very Rare 17 Control Weather, Cure Wounds (5th Level), and Wall of Thorns

A creature that plays this instrument without being Attuned makes a Will Save against this item's DC.

Fail The instrument deals 2d4 Psychic Damage to the creature.

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Magic Action; Once each per Day: You can play the instrument to cast one of its Spells.

docs.title: Ioun Stone
docs.text:
Rare Wondrous Item, Attunement

Each Ioun Stone has a Type, which determines this item's rarity and effect.

Stone Rarity Effect Awareness Rare You gain Advantage on Initiative and Perception Checks. Protection Rare Your Armor Class increases by 1. Sustenance Rare You don't need to eat or drink. Reserve Rare This stone stores up to 5 Spell Levels. A creature within Reach can cast a Spell into this stone, storing it instead of producing its effect; without room, the Spell is expended with no effect. You can cast a stored Spell using the original caster's Spell Slot Level, Spell Save DC, Spell Attack Bonus, and Spellcasting Ability. Agility Very Rare Your Dexterity increases by 1. Fortitude Very Rare Your Constitution increases by 1. Insight Very Rare Your Wisdom increases by 1. Intellect Very Rare Your Intelligence increases by 1. Leadership Very Rare Your Charisma increases by 1. Strength Very Rare Your Strength increases by 1. Absorption Very Rare Reaction: You can cancel a 5th-Level or lower Spell cast by a creature within Reach, wasting the resources used to cast it. After this stone absorbs 20 Spell Levels, it burns out and loses its magic. Mastery Legendary Your Proficiency Bonus increases by 1. Regeneration Legendary While you have at least 1 Hit Point, you heal by 15 at the end of each hour.

You can have up to 3 Ioun Stones orbiting your head at a time. An orbiting stone counts as an object you wear. It avoids contact with other creatures and objects, adjusting its orbit to thwart all attempts to attack or snatch it.

docs.title: Toss
docs.text: Magic Action: You can toss this stone into the air, where it orbits up to 3 feet from your head and confers its effect.

docs.title: Stow
docs.text: Utilize Action: You can seize and stow any number of Ioun Stones orbiting your head. After your Attunement to an orbiting stone ends, it falls as though you had dropped it.

docs.title: Iron Bands
docs.text: Rare Wondrous Item

docs.title: Bind
docs.text:
Magic Action; Once per Day: You can throw this sphere at a Huge or smaller creature within 60 feet, making a Ranged Attack Roll (+7 to hit).

Hit You restrain the target until you release it.

After the Attack misses, or after you release the target as a Bonus Action, the bands contract into a sphere again.

docs.title: Break Bands
docs.text:
Any creature that can reach the bands, including the Restrained creature, can take this Action.

Utilize Action: The creature makes an Athletics Check (DC 20). On a success, this item is destroyed and the Restrained creature is freed. On a failure, that creature's further attempts automatically fail for 24 hours.

docs.title: Item of Resistance
docs.text:
Rare Wondrous Item

Each Item of Resistance has an Elemental or Esoteric Damage Type.

You gain Resistance to the item's Damage Type.

docs.title: Ivory Goats Figurine
docs.text:
Rare Wondrous Item

These figurines are always created in sets of 3, and each is animated separately.

Goat Creature Duration Cooldown Terror Giant Goat 3 hours 15 Days Traveling Riding Horse 24 hours 7 Days Travail Giant Goat 3 hours 30 Days

docs.title: Terror
docs.text:
The Goat of Terror can't Attack. While you ride it, each Enemy that starts its Turn in a 30-foot Aura originating from the goat makes a Will Save (DC 15).

Fail You frighten the target for 1 minute, until you stop riding the goat, or until the goat reverts. Success The target gains Immunity to this effect for 24 hours.

Before the target's Turn ends, it repeats this Saving Throw.

Fail No additional effect. Success This effect ends on the target.

docs.title: Animate Goat
docs.text: Magic Action: You can throw one figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet, where you animate it as its Companion creature. It stays animated for the listed duration, until it drops to 0 Hit Points, or until you use this Action again.

docs.title: Command
docs.text: Free Action: You can command the goat to move and take any Action available to it.

docs.title: Remove Horn
docs.text: Magic Action: You can harmlessly remove one of the goat's horns, transforming it into a Polearm or a Blade until the goat reverts.

docs.title: Kinetic Bow
docs.text: Rare Weapon (Crossbow or Bow)

docs.title: Amplify
docs.text: Free Action; Once per Turn: You can give your next Ranged Attack with this weapon an additional Damage Die and double its Range.

docs.title: Lantern of the Frost Watch
docs.text: Rare Wondrous Item (Hooded Lantern)

docs.title: Command Word
docs.text:
Magic Action: You can speak 1 of the following Command Words to use its effect.

Command Aduro You ignite or extinguish this lantern's flame. Calidum Once per Day: This lantern's flame glows orange for up to 10 minutes. While glowing, everything within the lantern's Bright Light gains Cold Resistance. Micare Once per Day: This lantern's flame glows impossibly bright. Each other creature that can see the lantern makes a Fortitude Save (DC 15).Fail. You deal 4d6 Radiant Damage to the target.Success. You deal half as much damage. Revelare Once per Day: This lantern's flame glows green for up to 10 minutes. While glowing, every magical effect within the lantern's Bright Light is outlined with a faint glow, and magical darkness and fog within the Bright Light are suppressed. Vide Once per Day: This lantern's flame glows magenta for up to 10 minutes. While glowing, creatures within the lantern's Bright Light can't benefit from being Invisible, and are visible while on the Ethereal Plane (ethereal creatures still can't be targeted).

docs.title: Lightning Khopesh
docs.text:
Rare Weapon (Fence)

This weapon deals an additional 1d6 Lightning Damage. It has Graze, and its Graze deals Lightning Damage.

docs.title: Graze
docs.text: Free Action: After you miss with an Attack that had Advantage, you can use this weapon's Graze property even if you don't know it.

docs.title: Mantle of Spell Protection
docs.text:
Rare Clothing (Cloak), Attunement

You gain Magic Protection.

docs.title: Marble Elephant Figurine
docs.text: Rare Wondrous Item

docs.title: Animate Elephant
docs.text: Magic Action; Once per 7 Days: You can throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet, where you animate it as an Elephant Companion. It stays animated for 24 hours, until it drops to 0 Hit Points, or until you use this Action again.

docs.title: Command
docs.text: Free Action: You can command the elephant to move and take any Action available to it.

docs.title: Molten Skin
docs.text:
Rare Armor (Medium or Heavy)

While donned, you gain the following effects:

  • This armor can't be removed against your will.
  • You ignore this armor's Stealth penalty and Strength requirement.
  • You gain Fire Resistance.

docs.title: Necklace of Fireballs
docs.text:
Rare Clothing (Jewelry), Consumable

1d6 + 3 beads

docs.title: Hurl Bead
docs.text:
Utilize Action; 1 or more beads: You can detach beads from this necklace and throw them up to 60 feet, creating the effect of Fireball (DC 15) where they land. Increase the Fire Damage by 1d6 for each bead after the first, to a maximum of 12d6.

The thrown beads are destroyed.

docs.title: Necklace of Prayer Beads
docs.text:
Rare Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement (Cleric, Druid, or Paladin)

This necklace holds 1d4 + 2 magic beads. Each bead has a Spell, and a bead removed from the necklace loses its magic.

1d20 Bead Spell 1–6 Blessing Bless 7–12 Curing Cure Wounds (2nd Level) 13–16 Favor Greater Restoration 17–18 Smiting Shining Smite 19 Summons Guardian of Faith 20 Wind Walking Wind Walk

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Bonus Action; Once each per Day: You can cast one of the necklace's Spells from its bead.

docs.title: Nine Lives Stealer
docs.text:
Rare Weapon (Any), Attunement

1d8 + 1 uses

After you score a Critical Hit with this weapon against a creature that has fewer than 100 Hit Points and isn't a Construct or Undead, the target makes a Fortitude Save (DC 15).

Fail The target dies, and you expend 1 use. Success No effect.

After this item's last use is expended, it loses this effect.

docs.title: Onyx Dog Figurine
docs.text: Rare Wondrous Item

docs.title: Animate Mastiff
docs.text: Magic Action; Once per 7 Days: You can throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet, where you animate it as a Mastiff Companion. It stays animated for 6 hours, until it drops to 0 Hit Points, or until you use this Action again. The mastiff has an Intelligence of -1, speaks Common, and has 60 feet of Blindsight.

docs.title: Command
docs.text: Free Action: You can command the mastiff to move and take any Action available to it.

docs.title: Periapt of Proof against Poison
docs.text:
Rare Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

You gain Poison Immunity and Sickness Immunity.

docs.title: Portable Hole
docs.text:
Rare Container (Cloth)

This cloth folds to the size of a handkerchief and unfolds into a circular sheet 6 feet in diameter. It weighs next to nothing no matter what it holds, and holds enough air for 1 hour of breathing while closed, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.

docs.title: Open
docs.text: Magic Action: You can unfold this cloth against a solid surface, creating an extradimensional hole 10 feet deep. A creature inside can climb out.

docs.title: Close
docs.text: Magic Action: You can fold this cloth up, closing the hole. Anything inside remains in the extradimensional space.

docs.title: Force Out
docs.text:
Any creature in the extradimensional space can take this Action.

Utilize Action: The creature makes an Athletics Check (DC 10). On a success, it appears within 5 feet of this item.

docs.title: Quarterstaff of the Acrobat
docs.text:
Rare Weapon (Staff), Attunement

While in Staff form, this weapon has Thrown (30/120 feet), and after a Ranged Attack with it hits or misses, it returns to your hand.

While in Staff or Pole form, you gain Advantage on Acrobatics Checks.

docs.title: Emit Light
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can make this weapon emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet, or extinguish it. You can also emit the light after you roll Initiative.

docs.title: Alter Form
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can transform this weapon into a 6-inch rod or a 10-foot pole, or revert it to a Staff. It elongates only as far as the surrounding space allows.

docs.title: Attack Deflection
docs.text: Reaction; 3 times per Day: While in Staff form, before you are hit by an Attack, you can add 5 to your Armor Class against it.

docs.title: Ring of Animal Influence
docs.text:
Rare Clothing (Jewelry)

3 Charges (regain 1d3 per Day)

docs.title: Cast
docs.text:
You can cast the following Spells (DC 15):

Spell Action Charges Animal Friendship Magic Action 1 Charge Fear (Beasts only) Magic Action 1 Charge Speak with Animals Magic Action 1 Charge

docs.title: Ring of Evasion
docs.text:
Rare Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

You gain Reflex Evasion.

docs.title: Ring of Feather Falling
docs.text:
Rare Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

You gain the effect of Feather Fall.

docs.title: Ring of Free Action
docs.text:
Rare Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

You gain the effect of Freedom of Movement.

docs.title: Ring of Protection
docs.text:
Rare Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

Your Armor Class and Saving Throws increase by 1.

docs.title: Ring of Spell Storing
docs.text:
Rare Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement (Spellcaster)

6 Charges (regain 1d4 + 2 per Day)

docs.title: Channel
docs.text: Free Action; 1 or more Charges: Before you cast a Spell using a Spell Slot whose Level is no more than this item's remaining Charges, you can roll 1d6. If the roll is at least the Spell's Level, you cast the Spell spending 1 Charge per Spell Level instead of a Spell Slot. Otherwise, you cast the Spell using a Spell Slot as normal; without a Spell Slot, the casting fails (the Casting Time is still expended).

docs.title: Ring of Starmetal
docs.text:
Rare Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

After a Short Rest, you can bond an object weighing no more than 25 pounds that is at least 50% metal to the ring. Only 1 item can be bound to the ring at a time.

docs.title: Recall
docs.text: Bonus Action: While the bound item is within 60 feet and unobstructed, you can propel it to your hand. The returning item bounces harmlessly against creatures and objects as it passes by.

docs.title: Ring of the Ram
docs.text:
Rare Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

3 Charges (regain 1d3 per Day)

docs.title: Ram
docs.text:
Magic Action; 1 or more Charges: You can conjure a force-driven ram and make a Ranged Attack Roll with a +7 bonus against a target within 60 feet.

Hit You deal 2d10 Force Damage and propel the target up to 5 feet away from you.

Increase the Force Damage by 2d10 and the distance propelled by 5 feet for each additional Charge expended.

docs.title: Ring of X-ray Vision
docs.text: Rare Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

docs.title: See Through
docs.text:
Magic Action: You can see through solid objects within 30 feet of you for 1 minute. This vision penetrates 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, or 3 feet of wood or dirt. Thicker substances and lead block it.

After you use this Action again before finishing a Long Rest, you make a Fortitude Save (DC 15).

Fail You gain 1 Exhaustion level. Success No effect.

docs.title: Robe of Eyes
docs.text:
Rare Clothing (Clothes), Attunement

You gain 120 feet of Darkvision, 120 feet of Truesight, and Advantage on Perception Checks that rely on sight.

After Light is cast on this robe, or after Daylight is cast within 5 feet of it, you make a Fortitude Save (DC 11) against Light or (DC 15) against Daylight.

Fail You are Blinded for 1 minute. Success No effect.

Before your Turn ends, you repeat this Saving Throw.

Fail No additional effect. Success This effect ends on you.

docs.title: Rod of Rulership
docs.text: Rare Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus), Attunement

docs.title: Command Obedience
docs.text:
Magic Action; Once per Day: You can force each creature you choose within 120 feet to make a Will Save (DC 15).

Fail You charm the target for 8 hours, and it regards you as its trusted leader. Success No effect.

After you or your Allies harm the target, or after you command it to act against its nature, this effect ends on it.

docs.title: Rope of Entanglement
docs.text:
Rare Wondrous Item

This rope is 30 feet long, and has Armor Class 20 and 20 Hit Points. It heals by 1 every 5 minutes while it has at least 1 Hit Point, and is destroyed at 0 Hit Points.

docs.title: Entangle
docs.text:
Magic Action: While holding one end, you can command the other end to entangle one creature within 20 feet. The target makes a Reflex Save (DC 15).

Fail You restrain the target. Success No effect.

docs.title: Escape
docs.text:
Any Restrained creature can take this Action.

Utilize Action: The creature makes an Athletics or Acrobatics Check (DC 15). On a success, this effect ends on it.

docs.title: Release
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can release the target, coiling the rope in your hand. Letting go of your end instead coils the rope in the target's space.

docs.title: Scimitar of Speed
docs.text: Rare Weapon (Fence), Attunement

docs.title: Quick Cut
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can make 1 Attack with this weapon.

docs.title: Serpentine Owl Figurine
docs.text: Rare Wondrous Item

docs.title: Animate Giant Owl
docs.text: Magic Action; Once per 2 Days: You can throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet, where you animate it as a Giant Owl Companion. It stays animated for 8 hours, until it drops to 0 Hit Points, or until you use this Action again. You and the owl gain Telepathy with each other at any range on the same plane.

docs.title: Command
docs.text: Free Action: You can command the owl to move and take any Action available to it.

docs.title: Shield of the Cavalier
docs.text: Rare Shield (Any), Attunement

docs.title: Forceful Bash
docs.text:
1 Attack Action: You can make a Melee Attack Roll using this Shield against a target within 5 feet.

Hit You deal 2d6 + 2 + STR Force Damage, and you can propel the target up to 10 feet away from you or, if it is up to your Size, knock it Prone.

docs.title: Protective Field
docs.text:
Reaction; Once per Day: Before you or an Ally within 5 feet is attacked or makes a Saving Throw against an Area, you can cast Resilient Sphere (centered on the target, no Concentration required).

The triggering Attack or Area has no effect inside the sphere.

docs.title: Staff of Charming
docs.text:
Rare Weapon (Staff), Attunement (Spellcaster)

10 Charges (regain 1d8 + 2 per Day)

docs.title: Cast
docs.text:
You can cast the following Spells:

Spell Action Charges Charm Person Magic Action 1 Charge Command Magic Action 1 Charge Comprehend Languages Magic Action 1 Charge

docs.title: Reflect Enchantment
docs.text: Reaction; 1 Charge: After you succeed on a Saving Throw against an Enchantment Spell targeting only you, you can turn that Spell back on its caster as though you had cast it.

docs.title: Resist Enchantment
docs.text: Reaction; Once per Day: After you fail a Saving Throw against an Enchantment Spell targeting only you, you can succeed instead.

docs.title: Staff of Healing
docs.text:
Rare Weapon (Staff), Attunement (Spellcaster)

10 Charges (regain 1d6 + 4 per Day)

docs.title: Cast
docs.text:
You can cast the following Spells:

Spell Action Charges Cure Wounds Magic Action 1 or more Charges Lesser Restoration Magic Action 2 Charges Mass Cure Wounds Magic Action 5 Charges

Cure Wounds costs 1 Charge per Spell Level, to a maximum of 4.

docs.title: Staff of Striking
docs.text:
Rare Weapon (Staff), Attunement

10 Charges (regain 1d6 + 4 per Day)

docs.title: Strike
docs.text: Free Action; 1–3 Charges: Before you deal damage with a Melee Attack using this weapon, you can add 1d6 Force Damage for each Charge expended.

docs.title: Staff of Swarming Insects
docs.text:
Rare Weapon (Staff), Attunement (Spellcaster)

10 Charges (regain 1d6 + 4 per Day)

docs.title: Insect Cloud
docs.text: Magic Action; 1 Charge: You can fill a 30-foot Aura with a swarm of harmless flying insects for 10 minutes, making the area Heavily Obscured for everything but you. A strong wind disperses the swarm and ends this effect.

docs.title: Cast
docs.text:
You can cast the following Spells:

Spell Action Charges Summon Giant Insect Magic Action 4 Charges Insect Plague Magic Action 5 Charges

docs.title: Staff of Thunder and Lightning
docs.text: Rare Weapon (Staff), Attunement

docs.title: Lightning
docs.text: Free Action; Once per Day: Before you deal damage with a Melee Attack using this weapon, you can add 2d6 Lightning Damage.

docs.title: Thunder
docs.text:
Free Action; Once per Day: After you hit with a Melee Attack using this weapon, you can emit a crack of thunder audible out to 300 feet. The target makes a Fortitude Save (DC 15).

Fail The target is Stunned until the end of your next Turn. Success No effect.

docs.title: Thunder and Lightning
docs.text: Bonus Action; Once per Day: After you hit with a Melee Attack using this weapon, you can use Lightning and Thunder at the same time without expending their uses.

docs.title: Lightning Strike
docs.text:
Magic Action; Once per Day: You can leap a bolt of lightning from this weapon in a 120-foot × 5-foot Line. Everything in the Line makes a Reflex Save (DC 15).

Fail You deal 9d6 Lightning Damage to the target. Success You deal half as much damage.

docs.title: Thunderclap
docs.text:
Magic Action; Once per Day: You can conjure a thunderclap audible out to 600 feet. Everything in a 60-foot Aura makes a Fortitude Save (DC 15).

Fail You deal 2d6 Thunder Damage to the target and deafen it for 1 minute. Success You deal half as much damage.

docs.title: Staff of Withering
docs.text:
Rare Weapon (Staff), Attunement (Spellcaster)

3 Charges (regain 1d3 per Day)

docs.title: Wither
docs.text:
Free Action; 1 Charge: Before you deal damage with this weapon, you can add 2d10 Necrotic Damage. After you deal that damage, the target makes a Fortitude Save (DC Spell Save DC).

Fail The target gains Disadvantage on Strength and Constitution Checks and Fortitude Saves for 1 hour. Success No effect.

docs.title: Swan Boat Token
docs.text: Rare Wondrous Item, Consumable

docs.title: Conjure Boat
docs.text: Magic Action: You can place this token in a body of water at least 60 feet across within Reach, destroying the token and conjuring a self-propelled swan-shaped boat 50 feet long and 20 feet wide. The boat moves across water at 6 miles per hour and disappears after 24 hours or after you dismiss it.

docs.title: Steer
docs.text: Magic Action: While aboard, you can command the boat to move or to turn up to 90 degrees, or dismiss it.

docs.title: Sword of Life Stealing
docs.text:
Rare Weapon (Blade or Fence), Attunement

Critical Hits with this weapon deal an additional 15 Necrotic Damage to a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead, and you gain 15 Temporary Hit Points.

docs.title: Sword of Wounding
docs.text:
Rare Weapon (Blade or Fence), Attunement

This weapon deals an additional 2d6 Necrotic Damage.

After you hit a creature with this weapon, the target makes a Fortitude Save (DC 15).

Fail The target can't heal for 1 hour. Success No effect.

Before the target's Turn ends, it repeats this Saving Throw.

Fail No additional effect. Success This effect ends on the target.

docs.title: Tentacle Rod
docs.text: Rare Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus), Attunement

docs.title: Lash
docs.text:
Magic Action: You can direct this rod's 3 tentacles to each Attack a creature within 15 feet, making a Melee Attack Roll (+7 to hit) for each.

Hit You deal 1d6 Psychic Damage.

After all 3 tentacles hit the same target, it makes a Reflex Save (DC 15).

Fail You restrain the target.After the target's Turn starts, you deal 3d6 Psychic Damage to it. Success No effect.

This effect ends after you become Incapacitated, after you release the target as a Bonus Action, or after the target is more than 15 feet from you.

Before the target's Turn ends, it repeats this Saving Throw.

Fail No additional effect. Success This effect ends on the target.

docs.title: Two-Birds Weapon
docs.text:
Rare Weapon (Ranged or Thrown)

After you hit with a Ranged Attack using this weapon, you can attack a second target within 10 feet of the first (using the same weapon and Ammunition).

docs.title: Vessel of Commanding Elementals
docs.text:
Rare Wondrous Item

Vessel Elemental Type Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals Water Elemental Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals Fire Elemental Censer of Controlling Air Elementals Air Elemental Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals Earth Elemental

docs.title: Conjure Elemental
docs.text: Magic Action; Once per Day: While you are within 5 feet of the vessel, you can conjure an Elemental Companion of the vessel's Elemental Type in the nearest unoccupied space. It disappears after 1 hour, after it drops to 0 Hit Points, or after you dismiss it.

docs.title: Command
docs.text: Free Action: You can command the elemental to move and take any Action available to it, or dismiss it.

Rare Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus), Attunement

7 Charges (regain 1d6 + 1 per Day)

docs.title: Cast

Rare Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus), Attunement (Spellcaster)

7 Charges (regain 1d6 + 1 per Day)

docs.title: Cast

docs.title: Wand of Lightning Bolts
docs.text:
Rare Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus), Attunement (Spellcaster)

7 Charges (regain 1d6 + 1 per Day)

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Magic Action; 1 or more Charges: You can cast Lightning Bolt. Increase the Spell Level by 1 for each additional Charge expended.

docs.title: Wand of Paralysis
docs.text:
Rare Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus), Attunement (Spellcaster)

7 Charges (regain 1d6 + 1 per Day)

docs.title: Paralyze
docs.text:
Magic Action; 1 Charge: You can streak a thin blue ray at a creature within 60 feet. The target makes a Fortitude Save (DC Spell Save DC).

Fail You paralyze the target for 1 minute. Success No effect.

Before the target's Turn ends, it repeats this Saving Throw.

Fail No additional effect. Success This effect ends on the target.

docs.title: Wand of Wonder
docs.text:
Rare Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus), Attunement

7 Charges (regain 1d6 + 1 per Day)

docs.title: Wonder
docs.text:
Magic Action; 1 Charge: You can choose a point within 120 feet, which becomes the origin of a random effect. Spells cast from this wand use a DC of 15, and their Range becomes 120 feet if it would be shorter. Roll 1d100.

1d100 Effect 01–20 You cast a Spell originating from the point. Roll 1d10: on a 1 or 2, Darkness; on a 3 or 4, Faerie Fire; on a 5 or 6, Fireball; on a 7 or 8, Slow; on a 9 or 10, Stinking Cloud. 21–25 Nothing happens at the point. Instead, you are Stunned until the start of your next Turn, believing something awesome just happened. 26–30 You cast Gust of Wind, its Line extending from you to the point. 31–35 Nothing happens at the point. Instead, you take 1d6 Psychic Damage. 36–40 Heavy rain falls for 1 minute in a 120-foot-high, 60-foot radius Cylinder centered on the point, making the area Lightly Obscured. 41–45 A cloud of 600 oversized butterflies fills a 60-foot-high, 30-foot radius Cylinder centered on the point for 10 minutes, making the area Heavily Obscured. 46–50 You cast Lightning Bolt, its Line extending from you to the point. 51–55 The creature nearest the point gains the Enlarge effect of Enlarge/Reduce. If that creature can't be affected, you gain the effect instead. 56–60 A creature appears in the nearest unoccupied space, acts as it normally would, and disappears after 1 hour or after it drops to 0 Hit Points. Roll 1d4: on a 1, a Rhinoceros; on a 2, an Elephant; on a 3 or 4, a Rat. 61–64 Grass covers a 60-foot radius circle centered on the point. Grass already there grows to 10 times its size and remains overgrown for 1 minute. 65–68 An unattended object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension, within 120 feet of the point, disappears into the Ethereal Plane. 69–72 Nothing happens at the point. Instead, you gain the Reduce effect of Enlarge/Reduce for 1 minute. 73–77 Leaves grow from the creature nearest the point. Unless picked off, they turn brown and fall off after 24 hours. 78–82 Nothing happens at the point. Instead, a burst of shimmering light extends from you in a 30-foot Aura. Everything in the Aura makes a Fortitude Save (DC 15), becoming Blinded for 1 minute on a failure. Before the target's Turn ends, it repeats this Saving Throw. On a success, this effect ends on the target. 83–87 Nothing happens at the point. Instead, you cast Lesser Invisibility on yourself. 88–92 A stream of 1d4 × 10 gems worth 1 gold each shoots toward the point in a 30-foot × 5-foot Line. Each gem deals 1 Bludgeoning Damage, divided equally among everything in the Line. 93–97 You cast Polymorph on the creature nearest the point. Roll 1d4: on a 1, a Black Bear; on a 2, a Giant Wasp; on a 3 or 4, a Frog. 98–00 The creature nearest the point makes a Fortitude Save (DC 15), becoming Restrained and turning to stone on a failure. Before its next Turn ends, it repeats this Saving Throw. On a success, this effect ends on it; on a failure, it becomes Petrified until freed by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

After this petrification ends, you gain 2d6 + 3 Temporary Hit Points.

docs.title: Meta Crystal
docs.text:
Uncommon Wondrous Item, Consumable

Each Meta Crystal has a single Metamagic effect.

You can consume this item to use its Metamagic effect using the Metamagic's normal trigger, then this item becomes a nonmagical gemstone worth 50 gold.

docs.title: Nature's Mantle
docs.text:
Uncommon Clothing (Cloak), Attunement (Druid or Ranger)

This cloak is a Druidic Focus.

docs.title: Nature's Veil
docs.text: Bonus Action: While you are Lightly Obscured, you can Hide and remain hidden even while being directly observed.

docs.title: Necklace of Adaptation
docs.text:
Uncommon Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

You can breathe normally in any environment. You gain Poison Resistance and Sickness Protection.

docs.title: Pearl of Power
docs.text: Uncommon Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement (Spellcaster)

docs.title: Recover Slot
docs.text: Magic Action; Once per Day: You can regain 1 expended 3rd-Level or lower Spell Slot.

docs.title: Pegasus Quill
docs.text:
Uncommon Tool (Calligrapher's Supplies)

Writing activities, such as copying Spells or crafting Scrolls, take half as long.

docs.title: Periapt of Health
docs.text:
Uncommon Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

You gain Sickness Protection.

docs.title: Heal
docs.text: Magic Action; Once per Day: You can heal by 2d4 + 2.

docs.title: Periapt of Wound Closure
docs.text:
Uncommon Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

Your Death Saving Throws have a minimum Dice Roll of 10.

Healing you gain from spending Hit Dice becomes doubled.

docs.title: Pipes of Haunting
docs.text:
Uncommon Wondrous Item (Musical Instrument)

3 Charges (regain 1d3 per Day)

docs.title: Haunt
docs.text:
Magic Action; 1 Charge: You can force each creature you choose within 30 feet to make a Will Save (DC 13).

Fail The target is Frightened by you for 1 minute. Success The target gains Immunity to this item's effects for 24 hours.

Before a Frightened target's Turn ends, it repeats this Saving Throw.

Fail No additional effect. Success This effect ends on the target.

docs.title: Pipes of the Sewers
docs.text:
Uncommon Wondrous Item (Musical Instrument), Attunement

3 Charges (regain 1d3 per Day)

Rats are never your Enemy unless you harm them.

docs.title: Call Swarm
docs.text: Magic Action; 1–3 Charges: You can play the pipes, calling forth 1 Level 2 Swarm of Rats per Charge expended, provided enough rats are within half a mile (wasting the Charge otherwise). A called swarm moves toward the music by the shortest route but isn't otherwise under your control.

docs.title: Command Rats
docs.text:
Magic Action: You can play the pipes until the end of your next Turn.

While playing the pipes, after a Swarm of Rats not under another creature's control comes within 30 feet, it makes a Will Save (DC 13).

Fail The swarm becomes an Ally to you and your Allies and obeys your commands while you keep playing each Round; your control ends if it starts its Turn more than 30 feet from you. Success The swarm is unaffected and can't be swayed by the pipes for 24 hours.

docs.title: Portal Compass
docs.text:
Uncommon Wondrous Item

This compass points in the direction of the last portal it passed through while it and the portal are on the same plane. If that portal no longer exists, the needle becomes static until the compass passes through a new portal.

docs.title: Psi Crystal
docs.text:
Uncommon Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus), Attunement

You gain Telepathy and the crystal emits light. The range of the Telepathy and light increases with your Intelligence.

Intelligence Telepathy Bright Light Dim Light 0 15 feet — 5 feet 1 30 feet 5 feet 5 feet 2 60 feet 10 feet 10 feet 3+ 120 feet 15 feet 15 feet

docs.title: Quiver of Ehlonna
docs.text:
Uncommon Container (Quiver)

This quiver's 3 compartments are larger than their outside dimensions. The quiver can hold up to 60 Arrows or Bolts, 18 Javelins or similar objects, and 6 long objects such as Bows or Staves. You can draw any item it holds as if from an ordinary quiver.

docs.title: Ring of Jumping
docs.text:
Uncommon Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

You gain the effect of Jump.

docs.title: Ring of Mind Sharpening
docs.text:
Uncommon Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

4 Charges (regain 1d4 per Day)

docs.title: Sharpen Mind
docs.text: Reaction; 1 Charge: Before you fail a Concentration Save, you can succeed instead.

docs.title: Ring of Mind Shielding
docs.text:
Uncommon Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

You gain Immunity to magic that reads your thoughts, determines whether you are lying, or knows your alignment or Creature Type. Creatures can communicate telepathically with you only if you allow it.

After you die while attuned to the ring, your soul enters it, provided the ring doesn't already house a soul. While your soul is inside, you can communicate telepathically with whoever wears the ring, and you can choose to remain or depart for the afterlife.

docs.title: Conceal Ring
docs.text: Magic Action: You can turn the ring Invisible until you use this Action again, remove the ring, or die.

docs.title: Ring of Spell Refueling
docs.text: Uncommon Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement (Spellcaster)

docs.title: Quick Recovery
docs.text: Bonus Action; Once per Day: You can regain 1 expended 3rd-Level or lower Spell Slot.

docs.title: Ring of Swimming
docs.text:
Uncommon Clothing (Jewelry)

You gain a 40-foot Swim Speed.

docs.title: Ring of Warmth
docs.text:
Uncommon Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

Before you take Cold Damage, you reduce that damage by 2d8.

You and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower.

docs.title: Ring of Water Walking
docs.text: Uncommon Clothing (Jewelry)

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Magic Action: You can cast Water Walk, targeting yourself.

docs.title: Robe of Useful Items
docs.text: Uncommon Clothing (Clothes)

docs.title: Detach Patch
docs.text:
Magic Action: You can detach one of the robe's cloth patches, transforming it into the object it represents. Once the last patch is removed, the robe becomes an ordinary garment. The robe starts with 2 of each of the following patches, plus 4d4 more determined by the DM:

  • Bullseye Lantern (filled and lit)
  • Dagger
  • Mirror
  • Pole
  • Rope (coiled)
  • Sack

docs.title: Rope of Climbing
docs.text:
Uncommon Wondrous Item

This rope is 60 feet long and can hold up to 3,000 pounds. It has an Armor Class of 20 and 20 Hit Points. It regains 1 Hit Point every 5 minutes, but is destroyed if it drops to 0 Hit Points.

docs.title: Command Word
docs.text:
Magic Action: While holding one end of the rope, you can speak 1 of the following Command Words. Speak its opposite to end the effect.

Command Move / Stop Choose a point within 60 feet. Before your Turn ends, the other end moves 10 feet toward the chosen point. Fasten / Unfasten The other end securely fastens to an object. Knot / Unknot Large knots appear at 1-foot intervals, shortening the rope to 50 feet. Creatures gain Advantage on Athletics Checks to climb it. Coil / Uncoil All other effects end and the rope coils itself.

docs.title: Saddle of the Cavalier
docs.text:
Uncommon Wondrous Item

While you are conscious and in this saddle on a mount, you can't be dismounted against your will, and creatures gain Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against the mount.

docs.title: Sending Stones
docs.text:
Uncommon Wondrous Item

These stones come in a matched pair. While holding a stone, you know if a creature is holding the other stone and can broadcast sound to it.

docs.title: Broadcast
docs.text: Free Action: You can set broadcasting to your voice only, all sounds audible near the stone, or off.

docs.title: Sentinel Shield
docs.text:
Uncommon Shield (Any)

You gain Advantage on Initiative and Perception Checks.

docs.title: Shield of Feywatch
docs.text:
Uncommon Shield (Any)

Your Ability Checks and Saving Throws to see through illusions or resist Charm increase by 5.

docs.title: Shield of Protectors
docs.text: Uncommon Shield (Any)

docs.title: Protector's Ward
docs.text:
Reaction; Once per Day: Before a creature within 15 feet is hit with an Attack, you can force the target to make a Fortitude Save (DC 13).

Fail You teleport to the target's space and propel them 5 feet away from you. Then, the Attack hits you instead (even if the Attack Roll doesn't meet or exceed your AC). Success You teleport to within 5 feet of the target.

docs.title: Shield of Repulsion
docs.text:
Uncommon Shield (Any)

4 Charges (regain 1d4 per Day)

docs.title: Repulse
docs.text: Reaction; 1 Charge: After a Melee Attack damages you, you can propel the attacker up to 15 feet away from you.

docs.title: Silver Raven Figurine
docs.text: Uncommon Wondrous Item

docs.title: Animate Raven
docs.text: Magic Action; Once per 2 Days: You can throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet, where you animate it as a Raven Companion. It stays animated for 12 hours, until it drops to 0 Hit Points, or until you use this Action again.

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Magic Action: You can cast Animal Messenger, targeting the raven.

docs.title: Command
docs.text: Free Action: You can command the raven to move and take any Action available to it.

docs.title: Staff of the Adder
docs.text: Uncommon Weapon (Staff), Attunement

docs.title: Transform Head
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can transform the staff's head into a venomous snake. It keeps that form for 1 minute, or until you use this Action again.

docs.title: Strike
docs.text:
Free Action; Once per Turn: After you Attack, you can make a Melee Weapon Attack using the snake head. The attack uses your Wisdom, Proficiency Bonus, and Reach.

Hit You deal 1d6 Piercing Damage and 3d6 Poison Damage.

docs.title: Staff of the Python
docs.text: Uncommon Weapon (Staff), Attunement

docs.title: Animate Python
docs.text:
Magic Action: You can throw the staff up to 10 feet, where you animate it as a Giant Constrictor Snake Companion. It stays animated until you use this Action again.

If the snake drops to 0 Hit Points, the staff is destroyed; if the snake reverts to inanimate form before losing all its Hit Points, it regains them all.

docs.title: Command
docs.text: Free Action: You can command the snake to move and take any Action available to it.

docs.title: Stone of Good Luck
docs.text:
Uncommon Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

Your Ability Checks and Saving Throws increase by 1.

docs.title: Sun Blade
docs.text:
Uncommon Weapon (Blade), Attunement

This item appears to be a sword hilt. While its blade exists, it functions as a Blade with Finesse, deals Radiant Damage instead of Slashing Damage, and deals an additional 1d8 Radiant Damage to Undead.

The blade emits Bright Sunlight out to 15 feet and Dim Sunlight 15 feet further.

docs.title: Ignite
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can bring this weapon's blade of radiance into existence, or make it disappear.

docs.title: Adjust Light
docs.text: Magic Action: You can expand or reduce the blade's Bright Light and Dim Light by 5 feet each, to a maximum of 30 feet each or a minimum of 10 feet each.

docs.title: Tree Token
docs.text: Uncommon Wondrous Item, Consumable

docs.title: Conjure Tree
docs.text: Utilize Action: While outdoors, you can plant this token on the ground within Reach, destroying it and conjuring a nonmagical oak tree 60 feet tall with a 5-foot-diameter trunk and branches spreading in a 20-foot radius.

docs.title: Trident of Fish Command
docs.text:
Uncommon Weapon (Staff), Attunement

3 Charges (regain 1d3 per Day)

docs.title: Cast

docs.title: Wand of Magic Detection
