Uncommon Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus)

3 Charges (regain 1d3 per Day)

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Magic Action; 1 Charge: You can cast Detect Magic.

docs.title: Wand of Magic Missiles
docs.text:
Uncommon Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus)

7 Charges (regain 1d6 + 1 per Day)

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Magic Action; 1 or more Charges: You can cast Magic Missile. Increase the Spell Level by 1 for each additional Charge expended.

docs.title: Wand of Secrets
docs.text:
Uncommon Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus)

3 Charges (regain 1d3 per Day)

docs.title: Reveal Secrets
docs.text: Magic Action; 1 Charge: You can point the wand, revealing the nearest secret door or trap within 60 feet.

docs.title: Wand of Web
docs.text:
Uncommon Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus), Attunement (Spellcaster)

3 Charges (regain 1d3 per Day)

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Magic Action; 1 Charge: You can cast Web.

docs.title: Weapon of Biting
docs.text:
Uncommon Weapon (Sidearm, Foil, or Blade)

After you score a Critical Hit against a creature with this weapon, you bleed (1d6) the target.

docs.title: Weapon of Elements
docs.text:
Uncommon Weapon (Any)

Each Weapon of Elements has an Elemental Damage Type.

This weapon can deal its Elemental Damage Type instead of its normal Damage Type.

docs.title: Weapon of First Light
docs.text:
Uncommon Weapon (Sidearm, Foil, or Blade), Attunement

You gain Advantage on Initiative Checks.

After you roll Initiative, if you are first in the Initiative Order, your Speed increases by 15 feet until the end of your next Turn.

docs.title: First Light
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can give this item the effect of Light for 1 hour, or until you use this Action again. While the weapon is glowing, it can deal Radiant Damage instead of its normal Damage Type.

docs.title: Weapon of Radiance
docs.text:
Uncommon Weapon (Any), Attunement

4 Charges (regain 1d4 per Day)

docs.title: Illuminate
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can give this item the effect of Light for 1 hour, or until you use this Action again.

docs.title: Flash
docs.text:
Reaction; 1 Charge: Before you are attacked, you can force the attacker to make a Fortitude Save (DC 13).

Fail You blind the attacker until the end of its next Turn. Success No effect.

docs.title: Weapon of Repeating
docs.text:
Uncommon Weapon (Loading)

This weapon ignores its Loading property. Ranged Attacks with this weapon conjure their own Ammunition, which vanishes after the Attack.

docs.title: Weapon of Returning
docs.text:
Uncommon Weapon (Thrown)

After a Ranged Attack with this weapon hits or misses, it returns to your hand.

docs.title: Weapon of Smiting
docs.text:
Uncommon Weapon (Any)

Critical Hits with this weapon deal an additional 7 Bludgeoning Damage, or an additional 14 Bludgeoning Damage to a Construct. A Construct left with 25 Hit Points or fewer is destroyed.

docs.title: Weapon of Warning
docs.text:
Uncommon Weapon (Any), Attunement

You and your Allies within 30 feet gain Advantage on Initiative Checks.

Before you roll Initiative, your Allies within 30 feet wake from nonmagical sleep.

docs.title: Wind Fan
docs.text: Uncommon Wondrous Item

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Magic Action; 3 times per Day: You can cast Gust of Wind (DC 13).

docs.title: Winged Boots
docs.text:
Uncommon Clothing (Boots), Attunement

4 Charges (regain 1d4 per Day)

docs.title: Take Flight
docs.text: Magic Action; 1 Charge: You can gain a 30-foot Fly Speed for 1 hour. After it ends, if you are still aloft, you gain Falling Immunity and before your Turn ends, you descend 30 feet until you land.

docs.title: Radiance
docs.text:
Unique Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus, Holy Symbol), Attunement (Spellcaster)

Masterwork: Spell Attack 1

The spellcasting focus of Sylvarie, Archpriestess of Hanali Celanil. Given to the party as thanks for ending her petrification curse and restoring her body.

This wand is suffused with Holy Water and emits Dim Light out to 5 feet.

Spells cast using this wand ignore Half Cover.

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Bonus Action; Once per Day: You can cast Enhance Ability on yourself.

docs.title: Ammunition of Slaying
docs.text:
Very Rare Weapon (Ammunition), Consumable

Each Ammunition of Slaying has a Creature Type.

After this ammunition damages a creature of its Creature Type, the target makes a Fortitude Save (DC 17).

Fail You deal an additional 6d10 Force Damage to the target. Success You deal half as much additional damage.

Then, this ammunition becomes nonmagical.

docs.title: Amulet of the Planes
docs.text: Very Rare Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

docs.title: Plane Shift
docs.text:
Magic Action: You can name a location you are familiar with on another plane and make an Arcana Check (DC 17).

Success You cast Plane Shift to that location. Fail You and everything within 15 feet of you travel to a random destination. Roll 1d100. 1d100 Destination 01–60 A random location on the plane you named. 61–80 A random location on a random Inner Plane. 81–95 A random location on a random Outer Plane. 96–00 A random location on the Astral Plane.

docs.title: Animated Shield
docs.text: Very Rare Shield (Any), Attunement

docs.title: Hover
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can toss this Shield into the air, where it hovers in your space and protects you as though you donned it, leaving your hands free. It keeps hovering for 1 minute, until you use this Action again, or until you die or become Incapacitated, then falls into your free hand or to the ground.

docs.title: Bag of Devouring
docs.text:
Very Rare Container (Bag)

This bag resembles a Bag of Holding, but is the feeding orifice of a gigantic extradimensional creature. Turning it inside out closes the orifice.

Animal or vegetable matter placed wholly inside is devoured and lost forever. The bag holds a cubic foot of inanimate objects, but once per Day it swallows them and spits them out onto another plane.

If this bag is pierced or torn, it is destroyed, and everything inside travels to a random location on the Astral Plane.

docs.title: Reach Inside
docs.text:
Utilize Action: You can reach into the bag. Roll 1d10. On a 5 or lower, the bag pulls you inside.

After the end of a creature inside the bag's Turn, the creature is devoured and destroyed.

docs.title: Escape
docs.text:
Any creature inside the bag can take this Action.

Utilize Action: The creature makes an Athletics Check (DC 17). On a success, it climbs out.

docs.title: Extract
docs.text:
Any creature outside the bag can take this Action.

Utilize Action: The creature makes an Athletics Check (DC 20), provided the bag doesn't propel it inside first. On a success, it pulls one creature out of the bag.

docs.title: Belt of Giant Strength
docs.text:
Very Rare Clothing (Belt), Attunement

Each Belt of Giant Strength has a Giant, which determines this item's rarity and Strength.

Giant Rarity Strength Hill Rare 5 Stone Very Rare 6 Frost Very Rare 6 Fire Very Rare 7 Cloud Legendary 8 Storm Legendary 9

Your Strength becomes the belt's Strength, unless your Strength is already higher.

docs.title: Boots of Glacierpress
docs.text:
Very Rare Clothing (Boots)

3 Charges (regain 1d3 per Day)

Your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks, and you can move in a straight line through the space of any creature no more than 2 Sizes larger than you.

docs.title: Glacial Surge
docs.text:
Free Action; 1 Charge: Before you move into another creature's space, you can force the target to make a Fortitude Save (DC 17).

Fail While you move in a straight line, the target is propelled along the ground ahead of you until the end of the Turn or you end this effect (no action required). Success No effect.

docs.title: Candle of Invocation
docs.text:
Very Rare Wondrous Item (Candle), Consumable, Attunement

This candle burns for a total of 4 hours, and is destroyed once that time runs out. While lit, it emits Dim Light out to 30 feet.

In that light, you gain Advantage on Ability Checks, Attack Rolls, and Saving Throws, and a Cleric or Druid can cast their prepared 1st-Level Spells without expending a Spell Slot.

docs.title: Carpet of Flying
docs.text:
Very Rare Wondrous Item

Each Carpet of Flying has Dimensions, which determine its Capacity and Hover Speed.

Dimensions Capacity Hover Speed 3 ft. × 5 ft. 200 lb. 80 feet 4 ft. × 6 ft. 400 lb. 60 feet 5 ft. × 7 ft. 600 lb. 40 feet 6 ft. × 9 ft. 800 lb. 30 feet

A carpet can carry up to twice its Capacity, halving its Hover Speed.

docs.title: Command Word: Fly
docs.text: Magic Action: You can make this carpet hover until you use this Action again. While you are within 30 feet, the carpet moves according to your directions.

docs.title: Cauldron of Rebirth
docs.text:
Very Rare Wondrous Item, Attunement (Druid or Warlock)

You can use this cauldron as a Spellcasting Focus, and it serves as a Material component for Scrying.

docs.title: Brew Potion
docs.text: 1 minute; Once per Day: You can brew a Potion of Greater Healing. It loses its magic after 24 hours if not consumed.

docs.title: Resize
docs.text: Magic Action: You can transform this cauldron into one large enough for a Medium creature to crouch within, or revert it, harmlessly shunting anything that can't fit to the nearest unoccupied space.

docs.title: Raise Dead
docs.text: 8 hours; Once per 7 Days: You can place a Humanoid corpse in the enlarged cauldron and cover it with 200 pounds of salt worth 10 gold. The salt is consumed, and after the next Long Rest the creature returns to life as though by Raise Dead.

docs.title: Cloak of Arachnida
docs.text:
Very Rare Clothing (Cloak), Attunement

You gain the following effects:

  • You gain Poison Resistance.
  • You gain a Spider Climb Speed equal to your Speed.
  • You ignore movement penalties caused by webs.

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Magic Action; Once per Day: You can cast Web (DC 17), filling twice its normal area.

docs.title: Collar of Power
docs.text: Very Rare Clothing (Jewelry)

docs.title: Bond
docs.text: Magic Action: You can place this collar on a Companion within your Reach, or remove it. While attached, the collar can only be removed by the companion's bonded creature and resizes to fit the companion.

docs.title: Enlarge
docs.text: Bonus Action; Once per Day: You can give your companion the Enlarge effect of Enlarge/Reduce (no Concentration required).

docs.title: Enrage
docs.text: Free Action; Once per Day: After you drop to 0 Hit Points, you can give your companion the Enlarge effect of Enlarge/Reduce (no Concentration required) and 2d10 + LV Temporary Hit Points. While enlarged, the number of Attacks your Companion can make with its Attack Action increases by 1.

docs.title: Crystal Ball
docs.text: Very Rare Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus), Attunement

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Magic Action: You can cast Scrying (DC 17).

docs.title: Dancing Sword
docs.text: Very Rare Weapon (Blade or Fence), Attunement

docs.title: Dance
docs.text:
Bonus Action: You can toss this weapon into the air, where it hovers. You can move the weapon up to 30 feet, then Attack one creature within 5 feet of it. The weapon uses your Attack Roll and adds your Ability to its Damage Rolls.

While it hovers, you can use this Action again to move the weapon up to your Speed to a space within 30 feet of you, then Attack one creature within 5 feet of it.

After this weapon Attacks a fourth time, after you grasp it, or after you move more than 30 feet from it, it stops hovering and returns to your hand. Without a free hand, it falls to the ground in your space.

docs.title: Efreeti Bottle
docs.text: Very Rare Wondrous Item

docs.title: Unstopper
docs.text:
Magic Action; Once per Day: You can remove this bottle's stopper, releasing a cloud of smoke. Before your Turn ends, the smoke vanishes and an Efreeti appears within 30 feet.

The first time you open this bottle, roll 1d10 to determine the Efreeti's response.

1d10 Effect 1 The Efreeti is an Enemy and Attacks you. After 5 Rounds it disappears, and this bottle loses its magic. 2–9 The Efreeti becomes a Companion to you for 1 hour, then returns to the bottle. The stopper can't be removed for 24 hours. This happens the next two times the bottle is opened; on the fourth, the Efreeti escapes and this bottle loses its magic. 10 The Efreeti casts Wish once for you, then disappears, and this bottle loses its magic.

docs.title: Enspelled Item
docs.text:
Very Rare Weapon (Any) or Armor (Any), Attunement

6 Charges (regain 1d6 per Day)

This item holds a single Spell. The Spell Level determines this item's rarity, Spell Save DC, and Spell Attack Bonus.

Rarity Spell Level Spell Save DC Spell Attack Bonus Uncommon Cantrip or 1st-Level 13 +5 Rare 2nd-Level 15 +7 Very Rare 3rd-Level or 4th-Level 17 +9 Legendary 5th-Level 20 +12

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Magic Action; 1 Charge: You can cast the item's Spell.

docs.title: Frostburn Weapon
docs.text:
Very Rare Weapon (Thrown)

This weapon emits Bright Light out to 20 feet and Dim Light 20 feet further, and after a Ranged Attack using this weapon hits or misses, it returns to your hand.

This weapon deals an additional 1d6 Cold Damage, and a creature in its space gains Fire Resistance.

docs.title: Phase Shift
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can replace the additional Cold Damage with Fire Damage, and the Fire Resistance with Cold Resistance.

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Bonus Action; Once per Day: You can cast Fire Shield.

docs.title: Hammer of Polarity
docs.text:
Very Rare Weapon (Heavy, Bludgeoning Weapon), Attunement (Spellcaster)

7 Charges (regain 1d4 + 3 per Day)

You can use this weapon as a Spellcasting Focus. Spells you cast add your Spellcasting Ability to Lightning and Thunder Damage.

This weapon deals an additional 1d6 Lightning Damage and has Thrown (20/60 feet). After a Ranged Attack with this weapon hits or misses, it returns to your hand.

docs.title: Magnetic Compass
docs.text: Magic Action: You can make this weapon hover within your Reach, remaining upright and leaving your hands free. The weapon moves around you to indicate magnetic north until you use this Action again.

docs.title: Attraction Point
docs.text: Free Action; Once per Turn: After you hit a target up to your Size with this weapon, you can propel the target up to 10 feet closer or knock the target Prone.

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Reaction; 1 Charge: You can cast Shield.

docs.title: Emergency Repulsion
docs.text: Reaction; 4 Charges: Before you or a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, you can cast Resilient Sphere (centered on the target, no Concentration required).

docs.title: Hat of Many Spells
docs.text:
Very Rare Clothing (Hat), Attunement (Wizard)

You can use this hat as a Spellcasting Focus for your Wizard Spells. Spells you cast using it gain a Somatic component: you reach into the hat and draw the Spell out.

docs.title: Unknown Spell
docs.text:
Free Action; 3 times per Day: You can choose a 1st-Level or higher Wizard Spell that you don't know, of a Level you can cast and without Material components costing more than 1,000 gold. You expend a Spell Slot of the Spell's Level and make an Arcana Check (DC 10 + Spell Level).

Success You cast the Spell using its normal Casting Time. Fail The casting fails, and you roll 1d100 on the following table instead. 1d100 Effect 01–50 You cast a random Spell. Roll 1d10: on a 1, Enlarge/Reduce (Enlarge); on a 2, Enlarge/Reduce (Reduce); on a 3, Faerie Fire; on a 4, Fireball; on a 5, Gust of Wind; on a 6, Lesser Invisibility on yourself; on a 7, Lightning Bolt; on an 8, Phantasmal Force; on a 9, Polymorph; on a 10, Stinking Cloud. 51–55 You are Stunned until the end of your next Turn, believing something awesome just happened. 56–60 A harmless swarm of butterflies fills a 10-foot Cube within 30 feet, dispersing after 1 minute. 61–65 You pull a nonmagical object from the hat. Roll 1d4: on a 1, a Vial of Acid; on a 2, a Flask of Alchemist's Fire; on a 3, a Crowbar; on a 4, a lit Torch. 66–70 You are Sickened for 1 hour. 71–75 You are Petrified until the end of your next Turn. 76–80 You pull a nonmagical object from the hat. Roll 1d4: on a 1, a Dagger; on a 2, a Rope with a Grappling Hook tied to one end; on a 3, a bag of Caltrops; on a 4, a gem worth 50 gold. 81–85 A creature appears in the nearest unoccupied space, acts as it normally would, and disappears after 1 hour or after it drops to 0 Hit Points. Roll 1d4: on a 1, a Camel; on a 2, a Constrictor Snake; on a 3, an Elephant; on a 4, a Mule. 86–90 An Enemy Level 2 Swarm of Bats flies out of the hat, occupies your space, and Attacks you. 91–95 A vertical 10-foot-diameter two-way portal to another plane opens within 30 feet and remains until the end of your next Turn. 96–00 You pull a magic item from the hat, which disappears after 1 hour unless consumed or destroyed. Roll 1d6: on a 1 to 3, a Common item; on a 4 or 5, an Uncommon item; on a 6, a Rare item.

docs.title: Helm of Brilliance
docs.text:
Very Rare Clothing (Hat), Attunement

This helm is set with 1d10 diamonds, 2d10 rubies, 3d10 fire opals, and 4d10 opals. A gem pried from the helm crumbles to dust, and the helm loses its magic after all its gems are removed or destroyed.

While the helm has at least one ruby, you gain Fire Resistance.

While the helm has at least one diamond, it emits a 30-foot Aura. While at least one Undead is in the Aura, the Aura fills with Dim Light and deals 1d6 Radiant Damage to each Undead that starts its Turn there.

docs.title: Ignite Weapon
docs.text: Magic Action: While the helm has at least one fire opal, you can engulf one weapon you hold in harmless flames that emit Bright Light out to 10 feet and Dim Light 10 feet further. While ablaze, that weapon deals an additional 1d6 Fire Damage. The flames last until you extinguish them as a Bonus Action or until you drop or stow the weapon.

docs.title: Cast
docs.text:
You can cast the following Spells (DC 17), destroying the listed gem:

Spell Action Gem Daylight Magic Action Opal Fireball Magic Action Fire Opal Wall of Fire Magic Action Ruby Prismatic Spray Magic Action Diamond

docs.title: Horn of Valhalla
docs.text:
Very Rare Wondrous Item (Musical Instrument)

Each Horn of Valhalla has a Metal, which determines this item's rarity, how many warriors it conjures, and the Proficiency needed to command them.

Metal Rarity Berserkers Proficiency Silver Rare 2 — Brass Rare 3 Simple Weapons Bronze Very Rare 4 Medium Armor Iron Legendary 5 All Martial Weapons

docs.title: Conjure Warriors
docs.text:
Magic Action; Once per 7 Days: You can blow the horn, conjuring the listed number of Berserker Companions within 60 feet. They gain Charm Immunity and Fear Immunity, and disappear after 1 hour or after dropping to 0 Hit Points.

Without the horn's Proficiency, the Berserkers are Enemies that Attack you instead.

docs.title: Command
docs.text: Free Action: You can command the Berserkers to move and take any Action available to them.

docs.title: Horseshoes of a Zephyr
docs.text:
Very Rare Wondrous Item

These horseshoes come in a set of 4. While all of them are affixed to the same creature, it gains the following effects:

  • It floats 4 inches above any surface, letting it cross or stand above nonsolid and unstable surfaces.
  • It leaves no tracks.
  • It ignores Difficult Terrain.
  • It can travel up to 12 hours a day without gaining Exhaustion levels.

docs.title: Affix
docs.text: 1 minute: You can affix all 4 horseshoes to the hooves of a creature within Reach, or remove them.

docs.title: Instrument of the Bards
docs.text:
Very Rare Wondrous Item (Musical Instrument), Attunement (Bard)

This instrument comes in several types, each named for a bard college. The college determines this item's rarity, Spell Save DC, and the Spells it can cast.

College Rarity DC Spells All — — Fly, Lesser Invisibility, Levitate, and Protection from Good and Evil Doss Lute Uncommon 13 Animal Friendship, Protection from Energy (Fire Damage only), and Protection from Poison Fochlucan Bandore Uncommon 13 Entangle, Faerie Fire, Shillelagh, and Speak with Animals Mac-Fuirmidh Cittern Uncommon 13 Barkskin, Cure Wounds, and Fog Cloud Canaith Mandolin Rare 15 Cure Wounds (3rd Level), Dispel Magic, and Protection from Energy (Lightning Damage only) Cli Lyre Rare 15 Stone Shape, Wall of Fire, and Wind Wall Anstruth Harp Very Rare 17 Control Weather, Cure Wounds (5th Level), and Wall of Thorns

A creature that plays this instrument without being Attuned makes a Will Save against this item's DC.

Fail The instrument deals 2d4 Psychic Damage to the creature.

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Magic Action; Once each per Day: You can play the instrument to cast one of its Spells.

docs.title: Ioun Stone
docs.text:
Very Rare Wondrous Item, Attunement

Each Ioun Stone has a Type, which determines this item's rarity and effect.

Stone Rarity Effect Awareness Rare You gain Advantage on Initiative and Perception Checks. Protection Rare Your Armor Class increases by 1. Sustenance Rare You don't need to eat or drink. Reserve Rare This stone stores up to 5 Spell Levels. A creature within Reach can cast a Spell into this stone, storing it instead of producing its effect; without room, the Spell is expended with no effect. You can cast a stored Spell using the original caster's Spell Slot Level, Spell Save DC, Spell Attack Bonus, and Spellcasting Ability. Agility Very Rare Your Dexterity increases by 1. Fortitude Very Rare Your Constitution increases by 1. Insight Very Rare Your Wisdom increases by 1. Intellect Very Rare Your Intelligence increases by 1. Leadership Very Rare Your Charisma increases by 1. Strength Very Rare Your Strength increases by 1. Absorption Very Rare Reaction: You can cancel a 5th-Level or lower Spell cast by a creature within Reach, wasting the resources used to cast it. After this stone absorbs 20 Spell Levels, it burns out and loses its magic. Mastery Legendary Your Proficiency Bonus increases by 1. Regeneration Legendary While you have at least 1 Hit Point, you heal by 15 at the end of each hour.

You can have up to 3 Ioun Stones orbiting your head at a time. An orbiting stone counts as an object you wear. It avoids contact with other creatures and objects, adjusting its orbit to thwart all attempts to attack or snatch it.

docs.title: Toss
docs.text: Magic Action: You can toss this stone into the air, where it orbits up to 3 feet from your head and confers its effect.

docs.title: Stow
docs.text: Utilize Action: You can seize and stow any number of Ioun Stones orbiting your head. After your Attunement to an orbiting stone ends, it falls as though you had dropped it.

docs.title: Lute of Thunderous Thumping
docs.text:
Very Rare Weapon (Staff)

This lute deals an additional 2d8 Thunder Damage.

While you are a Bard and sing or hum, its Melee Attack Rolls can use your Charisma instead of your Strength.

docs.title: Manual of Golems
docs.text:
Very Rare Wondrous Item, Consumable

Each Manual of Golems has a Golem, which determines the time and gold needed to build it.

Golem Time Cost Clay 30 days 65,000 gold Flesh 60 days 50,000 gold Stone 90 days 80,000 gold Iron 120 days 100,000 gold

A creature that reads this manual without being a Spellcaster with two 5th-Level Spell Slots takes 6d6 Psychic Damage.

docs.title: Build Golem
docs.text: You can work without interruption, resting no more than 8 hours per day, for the listed Time and Cost. After that time, this manual is destroyed and you animate the golem as your Companion.

docs.title: Marvelous Pigments
docs.text:
Very Rare Wondrous Item, Consumable

1d4 uses

docs.title: Paint
docs.text:
10 minutes; 1 use: You can paint any number of three-dimensional objects and terrain features confined to a 20-foot Cube, which become real. This requires Concentration, and you must remain in the Cube; otherwise the painted elements vanish and the use is wasted.

No painted object can be worth more than 25 gold, and the total worth of one use can't exceed 500 gold. More valuable objects look authentic, but close inspection reveals them to be worthless.

docs.title: Mirror of Life Trapping
docs.text:
Very Rare Wondrous Item

This mirror is 4 feet tall and 2 feet wide, and has Armor Class 11, 10 Hit Points, and Bludgeoning Vulnerability. It shatters and is destroyed at 0 Hit Points, freeing everything trapped inside.

This mirror holds twelve extradimensional cells, each an infinite fog-filled expanse with visibility out to 10 feet. A creature trapped in a cell doesn't age and doesn't need to eat, drink, or sleep, and can escape only through magic that permits planar travel.

docs.title: Command Word
docs.text:
Magic Action: You can speak 1 of the following Command Words to use its effect.

Command Awaken While within 5 feet of this mirror, you activate it. While active, each creature other than you that sees its reflection within 30 feet makes a Will Save (DC 17). A creature that knows this mirror's nature gains Advantage, and a Construct automatically succeeds. On a failure, the target is trapped in one of the mirror's cells with everything it wears and carries.If every cell is occupied, the mirror frees one trapped creature at random, which appears in sight of the mirror and facing away from it. Sleep While within 5 feet of this mirror, you deactivate it. Appear You name one creature trapped in this mirror or call out a cell by number. That creature appears on the mirror's surface, and you can communicate with it. Release You name one creature trapped in this mirror or call out a cell by number. That creature appears with its possessions in the nearest unoccupied space, facing away from the mirror.

docs.title: Oathbow
docs.text:
Very Rare Weapon (Bow), Attunement

You gain Advantage on Ranged Attack Rolls with this weapon against a creature you Marked, and those Attacks ignore Long Range penalties and Cover and deal an additional 3d6 Piercing Damage.

While you have a creature Marked, you gain Disadvantage on Attack Rolls with other weapons.

docs.title: Swear Enmity
docs.text: Free Action: Before you make a Ranged Attack with this weapon, you can Mark the target for 7 days or until it dies. You can have only one creature Marked this way at a time.

docs.title: Obsidian Steed Figurine
docs.text: Very Rare Wondrous Item

docs.title: Animate Nightmare
docs.text:
Magic Action; Once per 5 Days: You can throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet, where you animate it as a Nightmare Companion that fights only to defend itself. Then, roll 1d10. On a 1, the nightmare becomes an Enemy and ignores your commands; while you ride it, it instead transports you both to a random location on Hades, then reverts to figurine form.

It stays animated for 24 hours, until it drops to 0 Hit Points, or until you use this Action again.

docs.title: Command
docs.text: Free Action: You can command the nightmare to move and take any Action available to it.

docs.title: Ring of Regeneration
docs.text:
Very Rare Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

While you have at least 1 Hit Point, you heal by 1d6 every 10 minutes, and a lost body part regrows and returns to full function after 1d6 + 1 days.

docs.title: Ring of Shooting Stars
docs.text:
Very Rare Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement (Spellcaster)

6 Charges (regain 1d6 per Day)

docs.title: Cast
docs.text:
You can cast the following Spells:

Spell Action Charges Dancing Lights Magic Action — Light Magic Action — Starry Wisp Magic Action — Cure Wounds Magic Action 1–3 Charges Faerie Fire Magic Action 1–3 Charges Guiding Bolt Magic Action 1–3 Charges

Increase the Spell Level by 1 for each additional Charge expended.

docs.title: Shooting Stars
docs.text:
Magic Action; 1–3 Charges: For each Charge expended, you can choose a 10-foot radius Sphere within 60 feet. Everything in the area makes a Reflex Save (DC Spell Save DC).

Fail You deal 5d4 Radiant Damage. Success You deal half as much damage.

docs.title: Celestial Body
docs.text:
After a Long Rest, choose 1 of the following effects:

Effect Sun Free Action: Before you cast a Spell, you can replace every instance of the Fire Damage Type in it with the Radiant Damage Type, or the reverse. Moon Free Action: After you use magic to heal another creature, you can gain Spellcasting Ability Temporary Hit Points. While you have these Temporary Hit Points, you gain Fear Immunity. Meteor Free Action: After you use Shooting Stars, you can teleport to a space in any of the areas.

docs.title: Change Sign
docs.text: Bonus Action; 1 Charge: You can change your Celestial Body effect.

docs.title: Ring of Telekinesis
docs.text: Very Rare Clothing (Jewelry), Attunement

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Magic Action: You can cast Telekinesis.

docs.title: Robe of Scintillating Colors
docs.text:
Very Rare Clothing (Clothes), Attunement

3 Charges (regain 1d3 per Day)

docs.title: Scintillate
docs.text:
Magic Action; 1 Charge: You can display a shifting pattern of dazzling hues until the end of your next Turn. The robe emits Bright Light out to 30 feet and Dim Light 30 feet further, and creatures gain Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against you.

Each creature in the Bright Light makes a Will Save (DC 17).

Fail The target is Stunned until this effect ends. Success No effect.

docs.title: Robe of Stars
docs.text:
Very Rare Clothing (Clothes), Attunement

6 Charges (regain 1d6 per Day)

Your Saving Throws increase by 1.

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Magic Action; 1 Charge: You can cast Magic Missile at 5th Level.

docs.title: Enter the Astral Plane
docs.text: Magic Action: You can enter the Astral Plane with everything you wear and carry, remaining until you use this Action again. You reappear in the space you left, or the nearest unoccupied space.

docs.title: Rod of Absorption
docs.text:
Very Rare Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus), Attunement

This rod holds 1d10 Spell Levels when found, and can absorb 50 Spell Levels over its existence. After it can absorb no more and holds none, it becomes nonmagical.

While Attuned, you know how many Spell Levels this rod has absorbed and how many it holds.

docs.title: Absorb Spell
docs.text: Reaction: Before a Spell targets only you and creates no Area, you can cancel it. The Spell has no effect, the resources used to cast it are wasted, and this rod stores Spell Levels equal to the Spell's Level.

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Free Action: While you are a Spellcaster, you can spend this rod's stored Spell Levels in place of a Spell Slot of that Level, to a maximum of 5th Level and no higher than your own highest Spell Slot.

docs.title: Rod of Alertness
docs.text:
Very Rare Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus), Attunement

You gain Advantage on Initiative and Perception Checks.

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Magic Action: You can cast Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Detect Poison and Disease, or See Invisibility.

docs.title: Protective Aura
docs.text:
Magic Action; Once per Day: You can plant this rod in the ground, where its head emits Bright Light out to 60 feet and Dim Light 60 feet further for 10 minutes. In that Bright Light, the Armor Class and Saving Throws of you and your Allies increase by 1, and each of you senses the location of any Invisible creature there.

This effect ends early after a creature removes the rod from the ground as a Magic Action.

docs.title: Rod of Security
docs.text: Very Rare Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus)

docs.title: Retreat
docs.text:
Magic Action; Once per 10 Days: You can transport yourself and up to 199 Allies within 100 feet to a demiplane whose form you choose. It holds enough food and water to sustain its visitors and can't harm them, and anything else there exists only there.

Each hour spent there heals a visitor as though it had spent 1 Hit Die, and visitors don't age. They can remain for 200 days divided by the number of creatures present, rounded down.

After the time runs out, or after you use this Action again, every visitor reappears in the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space.

docs.title: Spellguard Shield
docs.text:
Very Rare Shield (Any), Attunement

You gain Magic Protection, and creatures gain Disadvantage on Spell Attack Rolls against you.

docs.title: Staff of Fire
docs.text:
Very Rare Weapon (Staff), Attunement (Spellcaster)

10 Charges (regain 1d6 + 4 per Day)

You gain Fire Resistance.

docs.title: Cast
docs.text:
You can cast the following Spells:

Spell Action Charges Burning Hands Magic Action 1 Charge Fireball Magic Action 3 Charges Wall of Fire Magic Action 4 Charges

docs.title: Staff of Frost
docs.text:
Very Rare Weapon (Staff), Attunement (Spellcaster)

10 Charges (regain 1d6 + 4 per Day)

You gain Cold Resistance.

docs.title: Cast
docs.text:
You can cast the following Spells:

Spell Action Charges Fog Cloud Magic Action 1 Charge Ice Storm Magic Action 4 Charges Wall of Ice Magic Action 4 Charges Cone of Cold Magic Action 5 Charges

docs.title: Staff of Power
docs.text:
Very Rare Weapon (Staff), Attunement (Spellcaster)

20 Charges (regain 2d8 + 4 per Day)

docs.title: Cast
docs.text:
You can cast the following Spells:

Spell Action Charges Magic Missile Magic Action 1 Charge Ray of Enfeeblement Magic Action 1 Charge Levitate Magic Action 2 Charges Cone of Cold Magic Action 5 Charges Fireball (5th Level) Magic Action 5 Charges Hold Monster Magic Action 5 Charges Lightning Bolt (5th Level) Magic Action 5 Charges Wall of Force Magic Action 5 Charges Globe of Invulnerability Magic Action 6 Charges

docs.title: Retributive Strike
docs.text:
Magic Action: You can break this staff, destroying it and releasing its magic in a 30-foot Aura originating from it. Roll 1d10; on a 5 or lower, you instantly travel to a random plane and avoid the explosion. Otherwise, you take Force Damage equal to 16 times its remaining Charges.

Everything else in the Aura makes a Reflex Save (DC Spell Save DC).

Fail You deal Force Damage to the target equal to 4 times the staff's remaining Charges. Success You deal half as much damage.

docs.title: Staff of the Woodlands
docs.text:
Very Rare Weapon (Staff), Attunement (Druid)

6 Charges (regain 1d6 per Day)

docs.title: Cast
docs.text:
You can cast the following Spells:

Spell Action Charges Animal Friendship Magic Action 1 Charge Speak with Animals Magic Action 1 Charge Barkskin Magic Action 2 Charges Locate Animals or Plants Magic Action 2 Charges Pass without Trace Magic Action 2 Charges Plant Growth Magic Action, or 8 Hours 3 Charges Speak with Plants Magic Action 3 Charges Awaken Magic Action 5 Charges Wall of Thorns Magic Action 6 Charges

docs.title: Tree Form
docs.text: Magic Action; 1 Charge: You can plant one end of this staff in earth, transforming it into a tree 60 feet tall with a 5-foot-diameter trunk and branches spreading in a 20-foot radius. While touching the tree, you can use this Action again to revert it, dropping any creature in it.

docs.title: Sword of Sharpness
docs.text:
Very Rare Weapon (Blade or Fence), Attunement

This weapon's Damage Dice are maximized against objects.

Critical Hits with this weapon deal an additional 14 Slashing Damage, and the target gains 1 Exhaustion level.

docs.title: Thunderous Greatclub
docs.text:
Very Rare Weapon (Hammer), Attunement

Your Strength becomes 5, unless your Strength is already higher.

This weapon deals an additional 1d8 Thunder Damage, or an additional 3d8 Thunder Damage to objects.

docs.title: Clap of Thunder
docs.text:
Magic Action: You can strike this weapon against a hard surface, creating a thunderclap audible out to 300 feet and a 30-foot Cone of thunderous energy. Everything in the Cone makes a Fortitude Save (DC 17).

Fail You knock the target Prone. Success No effect.

You deal 3d8 Thunder Damage to nonmagical objects in the Cone.

docs.title: Earthquake
docs.text:
Magic Action; Once per Day: You can strike this weapon against the ground, disturbing a 50-foot radius circle centered on the impact. You deal 50 Bludgeoning Damage to structures in contact with the ground there, and everything on the ground there makes a Reflex Save (DC 17).

Fail You knock the target Prone, and it makes a Concentration Save (DC 17). Success No effect.

You can also open a 30-foot-deep, 10-foot-wide fissure anywhere in the area. Everything on that spot makes a Reflex Save (DC 17).

Fail The target falls into the fissure. Success The target moves with the fissure's edge.

Any structure on that spot collapses into the fissure.

docs.title: Tome of Mastery
docs.text:
Very Rare Wondrous Item

Each Tome of Mastery has an Ability.

Tome Ability Manual of Gainful Exercise Strength Manual of Quickness of Action Dexterity Manual of Bodily Health Constitution Tome of Clear Thought Intelligence Tome of Understanding Wisdom Tome of Leadership and Influence Charisma

docs.title: Study
docs.text:
48 hours: You can study this tome over 6 days or fewer. Your Ability Maximum in the tome's Ability increases by 1, then that Ability increases by 1.

Then, this tome loses its magic.

docs.title: Wand of Polymorph
docs.text:
Very Rare Spellcasting Focus (Arcane Focus), Attunement (Spellcaster)

7 Charges (regain 1d6 + 1 per Day)

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Magic Action; 1 Charge: You can cast Polymorph.
