docs.text:
2nd-Level Necromancy

Classes Cleric, Paladin, Wizard Components V, S, M (consumes 2 Copper) Casting Time Magic Action, or Ritual Range Reach Area — Target 1 Corpse Duration 10 days

Each target doesn't decay and can't become Undead.

Time spent under this Spell's effect doesn't count against the time limit of resurrection Spells.

docs.title: Gust of Wind
docs.text:
2nd-Level Evocation

Classes Druid, Ranger, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range Reach Area A 60-ft. × 10-ft. Line Target Each Creature and Object Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

The area blasts strong wind and moves with you. Each foot of movement in the area costs 1 extra foot moving towards you.

After a target enters the area (including when this Spell is cast or the area moves), it makes a Fortitude Save. After your Turn starts, each target also makes this Saving Throw. A target only makes this Saving Throw once until the start of your next Turn.

Fail You propel the target 15 feet away from you. Success No effect.

docs.title: Rotate
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can rotate the area around you.

docs.title: Heat Metal
docs.text:
2nd-Level Transmutation

Classes Artificer, Bard, Druid Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 60 ft. Area — Target 1 metal Object Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

You take the following Action as part of casting this Spell.

docs.title: Sear
docs.text:
Bonus Action: You can deal 2d8 Fire Damage to the target and everything touching it, and a Creature that takes this damage makes a Fortitude Save.

Fail The creature drops the target if it can. If it doesn't, it gains Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Checks until the end of your next Turn. Success No additional effect.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1d8 damage per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Hold Person
docs.text:
2nd-Level Enchantment

Classes Bard, Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 60 ft. Area — Target 1 Humanoid Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

Each target makes a Will Save.

Fail You paralyze the target. Success No effect.

Before a Paralyzed target's Turn ends, it repeats this Saving Throw.

Fail No additional effect. Success This Spell ends on the target.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Immovable Object
docs.text:
2nd-Level Transmutation

Classes Artificer, Wizard Components V, S, M (consumes gold dust worth 25 Gold) Casting Time Magic Action Range Reach Area — Target 1 Object that weighs 10 pounds or less Duration 1 hour

You anchor each target, even defying gravity. After a target holds more than 8,000 pounds of weight, this Spell ends on it; less weight than that doesn't affect it.

docs.title: Overpower
docs.text:
Utilize Action: Any creature that can reach the target can make an Athletics Check against your Spell Save DC.

Success The creature can propel the target up to 10 feet, ignoring any weight the target holds. Fail No effect.

docs.title: Password
docs.text: After you cast this Spell, you can choose a password. After a creature speaks this password, or presents it visually, the creature ignores this Spell's effects.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text:
When Upcast to 3rd-Level, the weight limit is 10,000 pounds and the Duration is 8 hours.

When Upcast to 4th- or 5th-Level, the weight limit is 12,500 pounds, the Duration is 24 hours, and the Ability Check's DC increases by 5.

When Upcast to 6th-Level or higher, the weight limit is 20,000 pounds, the Duration is until dispelled, and the Ability Check's DC increases by 10.

docs.title: Kinetic Jaunt
docs.text:
2nd-Level Transmutation

Classes Artificer, Bard, Sorcerer, Wizard Components S Casting Time Bonus Action Range — Area — Target Self Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

Your Speed increases by 10 feet, your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks, and you can move freely through other creatures' spaces.

docs.title: Knock
docs.text:
2nd-Level Transmutation

Classes Artificer, Bard, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V Casting Time Magic Action Range 60 ft. Area — Target 1 Object Duration —

Each target emits a loud knocking sound out to 300 feet.

The effects of Arcane Lock on the target are suppressed for 10 minutes, and one mundane means of preventing access to the target (such as a lock, adhesive, or barrier) is undone.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Lesser Invisibility
docs.text:
2nd-Level Illusion

Classes Artificer, Bard, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range Reach Area — Target 1 Creature or Object Duration 1 hour (Concentration)

You turn each target Invisible. After a target attacks, deals damage, or casts a Spell, this Spell ends on it.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Lesser Restoration
docs.text:
2nd-Level Abjuration

Classes Artificer, Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger Components V, S Casting Time Bonus Action Range Reach Area — Target 1 Creature Duration —

You end 1 Blindness, Deafness, Paralysis, or Sickness on the target.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Levitate
docs.text:
2nd-Level Transmutation

Classes Artificer, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 60 ft. Area — Target 1 Creature or Object Duration 10 minutes (Concentration)

Each target makes a Fortitude Save.

Fail The target rises 20 feet and remains suspended, able to move only by climbing along a surface or Anchored object within Reach. After this Spell ends, the target lands and takes no damage from the fall. Success No effect.

docs.title: Move
docs.text: Magic Action: You can propel the target vertically up to 20 feet. If you are the target, you can instead do this as part of your movement.

docs.title: Locate Animals or Plants
docs.text:
2nd-Level Divination

Classes Bard, Druid, Ranger Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action, or Ritual Range 5 miles Area — Target 1 Beast, Plant Creature, or Plant Object you describe Duration 10 minutes (Concentration)

You describe a target by its Creature Type, its kind, or a specific individual. This Spell targets the nearest creature or object matching your description.

You gain the following effects:

  • You know the direction and distance to the target.
  • If the target is moving, you know the direction of its movement.

Any amount of lead blocks this Spell. It can't locate a target that has been transformed into a different form.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level. You can describe each target separately.

docs.title: Locate Object
docs.text:
2nd-Level Divination

Classes Artificer, Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action, or Ritual Range 1,000 ft. Area — Target 1 Object you describe Duration 10 minutes (Concentration)

You describe an object by its kind or a specific object. This Spell targets the nearest object matching your description.

You gain the following effects:

  • You know the direction and distance to the target.
  • If the target is moving, you know the direction of its movement.

Any amount of lead blocks this Spell. It can't locate a target that has been transformed into a different form.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level. You can describe each target separately.

docs.title: Magic Aura
docs.text:
2nd-Level Illusion

Classes Artificer, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range Reach Area — Target 1 Creature or Object Duration 24 hours

You alter how the target appears to magical effects.

Effect Creature Choose a Creature Type. Each target is treated as a creature of the chosen type instead of its usual type (Spells and effects that affect only the chosen type can affect the target). Object Choose a School of Magic, or none. Each target appears to contain magic of the chosen School, or to be nonmagical.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Magic Mouth
docs.text:
2nd-Level Illusion

Classes Artificer, Bard, Wizard Components V, S, M (consumes jade dust worth 10 Gold) Casting Time 1 minute, or Ritual Range 30 ft. Area — Target 1 Object Duration Until dispelled

You speak a short message, recording it in each target.

Choose a perceivable trigger, and whether the message repeats.

After the trigger occurs, you conjure a mouth on the target that recites the message in your voice, then if you chose not to repeat the message, this Spell ends on the target.

docs.title: Magic Weapon
docs.text:
2nd-Level Transmutation

Classes Artificer, Paladin, Ranger, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S Casting Time Bonus Action Range Reach Area — Target 1 Weapon Duration 1 hour

Each target's Physical Masterwork bonus becomes +1, unless it is already higher.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text:
When Upcast to 3rd- or 4th-Level, the bonus becomes +2.

When Upcast to 5th-Level or higher, the bonus becomes +3.

docs.title: Mind Spike
docs.text:
2nd-Level Divination

Classes Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard Components S Casting Time Magic Action Range 120 ft. Area — Target 1 Creature Duration 1 hour (Concentration)

Each target makes a Will Save.

Fail You deal 3d8 Psychic Damage, you mark the target. While marked and on the same plane, you know the target's location and it can't be Hidden from you or Invisible to you. Success You deal half as much damage.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1d8 damage per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Mind Whip
docs.text:
2nd-Level Enchantment

Classes Sorcerer, Wizard Components V Casting Time Magic Action Range 90 ft. Area — Target 1 Creature Duration Until the end of the target's next Turn

Each target makes a Will Save.

Fail You deal 3d6 Psychic Damage, and you daze the target until this Spell ends. Success You deal half as much damage.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Mirror Image
docs.text:
2nd-Level Illusion

Classes Bard, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range — Area — Target Self Duration 1 minute

You conjure 3 illusory duplicates of yourself that move with you, mimic your actions, and shift position to hide your true self.

After you are hit by an Attack, roll 1d6 for each remaining duplicate. If any roll is 3 or higher, a duplicate is hit instead and destroyed. The duplicates otherwise ignore all damage and effects.

docs.title: Misty Step
docs.text:
2nd-Level Conjuration

Classes Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard Components V Casting Time Bonus Action Range 30 ft. Area — Target Self Duration —

You teleport.

docs.title: Moonbeam
docs.text:
2nd-Level Transmutation

Classes Druid Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 120 ft. Area A 5-ft. radius, 40-ft. Cylinder from above Target Each Creature and Object Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

The area is filled with Dim Light, and shapeshifters can't change form within it.

After a target enters the area (including when this Spell is cast or the area moves), it makes a Fortitude Save. After your Turn starts, each target also makes this Saving Throw. A target only makes this Saving Throw once until the start of your next Turn.

Fail You deal 2d10 Radiant Damage. A shapeshifted target returns to its true form. Success You deal half as much damage.

docs.title: Move
docs.text: Magic Action: You can move the area up to 60 feet.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1d10 damage and 5 feet to the radius per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Pass Without Trace
docs.text:
2nd-Level Abjuration

Classes Druid, Ranger Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 30 ft. Area — Target Each Creature you choose Duration 1 hour (Concentration)

Each target's Stealth Checks increase by 10, and it leaves no tracks.

docs.title: Phantasmal Force
docs.text:
2nd-Level Illusion

Classes Bard, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 60 ft. Area — Target 1 Creature Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

Each target makes a Will Save.

Fail You conjure a Large or smaller illusion that only the target can perceive. The target believes the illusion is real and rationalizes any illogical outcomes from interacting with it. Success No effect.

docs.title: Torment
docs.text: Free Action: If a target is within 5 feet of the illusion, you can deal 2d8 Psychic Damage to it; the target perceives the damage as a type appropriate to the illusion.

docs.title: Search
docs.text:
A creature whose Passive Perception exceeds your Spell Save DC knows the illusion is false.

Search Action: Any creature that perceives the illusion can make a Perception Check against your Spell Save DC.

Success The creature knows the illusion is false and ignores its effects. Fail No effect.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Prayer of Healing
docs.text:
2nd-Level Abjuration

Classes Cleric, Paladin Components V Casting Time 10 minutes Range 30 ft. Area — Target Up to 5 Creatures Duration —

You heal each target by 2d8, and it gains the effect of a Short Rest.

A target can't be affected by this Spell again until it finishes a Long Rest.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1d8 to the healing per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Protection from Poison
docs.text:
2nd-Level Abjuration

Classes Artificer, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range Reach Area — Target 1 Creature Duration 1 hour

You end each Sickness on the target.

Each target gains Poison Resistance and Sickness Protection.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Pyrotechnics
docs.text:
2nd-Level Transmutation

Classes Artificer, Bard, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range 60 ft. Area A 20-ft. radius Sphere Target Each Creature and Object Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

Choose 1 of the following effects:

Effect Fireworks Each target makes a Fortitude Save.Fail. You deal 2d6 Fire Damage, and you blind the target until the end of its next Turn.Success. You deal half as much damage. Smoke The area gains the effect of Fog Cloud (the fog is smoke).

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1d6 damage and 10 feet to the radius per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Ray of Enfeeblement
docs.text:
2nd-Level Necromancy

Classes Warlock, Wizard Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range 60 ft. Area — Target 1 Creature Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

Each target makes a Fortitude Save.

Fail The target gains Disadvantage on Ability Checks, Attack Rolls, and Saving Throws that use Strength, and its Damage Rolls decrease by 1d8. Success The target gains Disadvantage on its next Attack Roll, then this Spell ends on the target.

Before a target's Turn ends, it repeats this Saving Throw.

Fail No additional effect. Success This Spell ends on the target.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Rope Trick
docs.text:
2nd-Level Transmutation

Classes Artificer, Wizard Components V, S, M (rope worth 1 Gold) Casting Time Magic Action Range Reach Area — Target — Duration 1 hour

One end of the Material Component hovers perpendicular to the ground, up to its length or until it reaches a ceiling. At the top, an invisible portal large enough for a Medium creature opens to an extradimensional space reachable by climbing the rope.

The space can hold up to 8 Medium or smaller creatures. Attacks, Spells, and other effects can't pass into or out of the space, but creatures inside can see through the portal. After this Spell ends, anything inside drops out.

docs.title: Scorching Ray
docs.text:
2nd-Level Evocation

Classes Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range 120 ft. Area — Target Up to 3 Creatures or Objects Duration —

You make a Ranged Spell Attack against each target.

Hit You deal 2d6 Fire Damage. You burn (1d4) a flammable object.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: See Invisibility
docs.text:
2nd-Level Divination

Classes Artificer, Bard, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range — Area — Target Self Duration 1 hour

You can see Invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible.

You can see into the Ethereal Plane.

docs.title: Shadow Blade
docs.text:
2nd-Level Illusion

Classes Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard Components V, S Casting Time Bonus Action Range — Area — Target Self Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

You conjure a sword of solidified shadow in your hand.

Weapon Damage Weight Hands Properties Techniques Shadow Blade 2d8 Psychic Light One Finesse, Thrown (20/60 feet) Nick, Sap, Slow, Vex

You gain Proficiency with the sword, your Attacks with it can use your Spellcasting Ability, and while in Dim Light or Darkness you gain Advantage on Attack Rolls with it.

After you drop or throw the sword, it vanishes.

docs.title: Resummon
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can conjure the sword in your hand.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1d8 damage per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Shatter
docs.text:
2nd-Level Evocation

Classes Artificer, Bard, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 60 ft. Area A 10-ft. radius Sphere Target Each Creature and Object Duration —

Each target makes a Fortitude Save.

Fail You deal 3d8 Thunder Damage. Objects and Constructs gain Vulnerability to this damage. Success You deal half as much damage.

This Spell's thunder is audible out to 300 feet.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1d8 damage and 5 feet to the radius per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Shining Smite
docs.text:
2nd-Level Transmutation

Classes Paladin Components V Casting Time Bonus Action, after you hit with a Melee Weapon Attack Range — Area — Target The target of the Attack Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

You deal 2d6 Radiant Damage and the target gains the following effects:

  • It emits Bright Light out to 5 feet.
  • It can't benefit from being Invisible.
  • Creatures gain Advantage on Attack Rolls against it.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1d6 Radiant Damage per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Silence
docs.text:
2nd-Level Illusion

Classes Bard, Cleric, Ranger Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action, or Ritual Range 120 ft. Area A 20-ft. radius Sphere Target Each Creature and Object Duration 10 minutes (Concentration)

Sound can't be created or heard in the area.

Each target is Deafened, gains Thunder Immunity, and can't cast Spells with Verbal components.

docs.title: Snowball Swarm
docs.text:
2nd-Level Evocation

Classes Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 90 ft. Area A 10-ft. radius Sphere Target Each Creature and Object Duration 1 minute

Each target makes a Reflex Save.

Fail You deal 3d6 Cold Damage, and the target's Speed decreases by 10 feet. Success You deal half as much damage.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1d6 damage and 30 feet to the Range per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Spider Climb
docs.text:
2nd-Level Transmutation

Classes Artificer, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range Reach Area — Target 1 Creature Duration 1 hour (Concentration)

Each target gains a Spider Climb Speed equal to its Speed.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Spike Growth
docs.text:
2nd-Level Transmutation

Classes Druid, Ranger Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 150 ft. Area A 20-ft. radius Sphere Target Each Creature and Object Duration 10 minutes (Concentration)

The area is Difficult Terrain and Hidden (Hide DC Spell Save DC).

You deal 2d4 Piercing Damage to a target that moves into or within the area for every 5 feet it moves.

docs.title: Spiritual Weapon
docs.text:
2nd-Level Evocation

Classes Cleric Components V, S Casting Time Bonus Action Range 60 ft. Area — Target — Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

You conjure an intangible, floating, spectral force resembling a weapon. The weapon is 2 Sizes smaller than you.

While the weapon shares your space, it moves with you.

You take the following Action as part of casting this Spell.

docs.title: Attack
docs.text:
Bonus Action: You can move the weapon up to your Speed, then make a Melee Attack against a Creature or Object within 5 feet of it.

Hit You deal 1d8 + Spellcasting Ability Force Damage.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1d8 damage per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Suggestion
docs.text:
2nd-Level Enchantment

Classes Bard, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard Components V, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 30 ft. Area — Target 1 Creature who understands you Duration 8 hours (Concentration)

You suggest a course of activity to the target in 25 words or fewer. The suggestion must sound achievable and must not obviously damage the target or its Allies.

Each target makes a Will Save.

Fail You charm the target until it completes the suggested activity, or until you or an Ally damage it. While Charmed by this Spell, a target follows the suggestion to the best of its ability. Success No effect.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Summon Beast
docs.text:
2nd-Level Conjuration

Classes Druid, Ranger Components V, S, M (a gilded acorn worth 200 Gold, containing a feather, a tuft of fur, and a scale) Casting Time Magic Action Range 90 ft. Area — Target — Duration 1 hour (Concentration)

Choose Land, Water, or Air.

You conjure a Bestial Spirit Companion. After the spirit drops to 0 Hit Points, this Spell ends.

docs.title: Command
docs.text: Free Action: You can command the spirit to move and take any Action available to it.

docs.title: Bestial Spirit: Land
docs.text:
Small Beast, Neutral

Defenses HP 22 [(8 + CON) × Spell Level] Hit Dice 1d8 per Spell Level AC 12 + PB [10 + DEX + Spell Level + PB] Armor Natural (Light) Abilities STR +4 DEX +0 CON +3 INT -3 WIS +2 CHA -3 Traits Languages Understands the Languages you know, but can't speak Senses Darkvision (60 ft.) Speed 30 ft., Climb 30 ft. Reach 5 ft. Features Pack Tactics The spirit gains Advantage on Attack Rolls while the target is within an Ally's Reach. Multiattack The spirit makes Spell Level ÷ 2 attacks, rounded down.

docs.title: Actions
docs.text: Beast Strike Melee Attack Range Reach Attack +Spell Attack to hit Damage 1d8 + 6 Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing Damage [1d8 + STR + Spell Level]

docs.title: Bestial Spirit: Sea
docs.text:
Small Beast, Neutral

Defenses HP 22 [(8 + CON) × Spell Level] Hit Dice 1d8 per Spell Level AC 12 + PB [10 + DEX + Spell Level + PB] Armor Natural (Light) Abilities STR +4 DEX +0 CON +3 INT -3 WIS +2 CHA -3 Traits Languages Understands the Languages you know, but can't speak Senses Darkvision (60 ft.) Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft. Reach 5 ft. Features Pack Tactics The spirit gains Advantage on Attack Rolls while the target is within an Ally's Reach. Water Breathing The spirit can only breathe underwater. Multiattack The spirit makes Spell Level ÷ 2 attacks, rounded down.

docs.title: Actions
docs.text: Beast Strike Melee Attack Range Reach Attack +Spell Attack to hit Damage 1d8 + 6 Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing Damage [1d8 + STR + Spell Level]

docs.title: Bestial Spirit: Sky
docs.text:
Small Beast, Neutral

Defenses HP 18 [(6 + CON) × Spell Level] Hit Dice 1d6 per Spell Level AC 12 + PB [10 + DEX + Spell Level + PB] Armor Natural (Light) Abilities STR +4 DEX +0 CON +3 INT -3 WIS +2 CHA -3 Traits Languages Understands the Languages you know, but can't speak Senses Darkvision (60 ft.) Speed 30 ft., Climb 30 ft. Reach 5 ft. Features Flyby The spirit's movement doesn't trigger Opportunity Attacks. Multiattack The spirit makes Spell Level ÷ 2 attacks, rounded down.

docs.title: Actions
docs.text: Beast Strike Melee Attack Range Reach Attack +Spell Attack to hit Damage 1d8 + 6 Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing Damage [1d8 + STR + Spell Level]

docs.title: Vortex Warp
docs.text:
2nd-Level Conjuration

Classes Artificer, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range 90 ft. Area — Target 1 other Creature or Object Duration —

Each target makes a Fortitude Save.

Fail You teleport the target to a space on the ground. Success No effect.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 30 feet of Range per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Warding Bond
docs.text:
2nd-Level Abjuration

Classes Cleric, Paladin Components V, S, M (two platinum rings worth 50 Gold each) Casting Time Magic Action Range — Area A 60-ft. Aura Target Any Creature Duration 1 hour

While you and a target each wear one of the Material Components, the target gains the following effects:

  • You increase the target's Armor Class and Saves by 1.
  • The target gains Resistance to all damage.
  • After the target takes damage, you take the same amount.

After you are Downed, this Spell ends. After this Spell is cast again on you or on a target, the previous casting ends.

docs.title: Warding Wind
docs.text:
2nd-Level Evocation

Classes Bard, Druid, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V Casting Time Magic Action Range — Area A 10-ft. Aura Target — Duration 10 minutes (Concentration)

You conjure strong wind in the area. The area gains the following effects:

  • Vapor, fog, and gas are dispersed.
  • Unprotected flames are extinguished.
  • Each target is Deafened.
  • The area is Difficult Terrain for creatures other than you.
  • Creatures gain Disadvantage on Ranged Weapon Attacks that pass through the area.

docs.title: Web
docs.text:
2nd-Level Conjuration

Classes Artificer, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 60 ft. Area A 20-ft. Cube Target Each Creature and Object Duration 1 hour (Concentration)

You conjure sticky webbing in the area. The area is Difficult Terrain and Lightly Obscured.

The webs are flammable. Any 5-foot Cube of webs exposed to fire burns away in 1 Round, dealing 2d4 Fire Damage to everything that enters or starts its Turn in the fire.

After a target enters the area (including when this Spell is cast), it makes a Reflex Save. After your Turn starts, each target also makes this Saving Throw. A target only makes this Saving Throw once until the start of your next Turn.

Fail You restrain the target. Success No effect.

docs.title: Escape
docs.text:
Utilize Action: Any Restrained target can make an Athletics Check against your Spell Save DC.

Success This effect ends on the target. Fail No effect.

docs.title: Wither and Bloom
docs.text:
2nd-Level Necromancy

Classes Druid, Warlock Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 60 ft. Area A 10-ft. radius Sphere Target Each Creature Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

One target can expend and roll up to 1 Hit Die, then you heal it by the total + Spellcasting Ability.

Each other target makes a Fortitude Save.

Fail You deal 2d6 Necrotic Damage. Success You deal half as much damage.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add up to 1 Hit Die, 1d6 damage, and 10 feet to the radius per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Zone of Truth
docs.text:
2nd-Level Enchantment

Classes Bard, Cleric, Paladin Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range 60 ft. Area A 15-ft. radius Sphere Target Each Creature Duration 10 minutes

After a target enters the area (including when this Spell is cast), it makes a Will Save. After your Turn starts, each target also makes this Saving Throw. A target only makes this Saving Throw once until the start of your next Turn.

You know whether each target succeeds or fails.

Fail The target can't speak a deliberate lie while in the area. It is aware of this effect and can remain silent. Success No effect.

docs.title: Animate Dead
docs.text:
3rd-Level Necromancy

Classes Cleric, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time 1 minute Range 10 ft. Area — Target 1 Humanoid Corpse, or up to 4 Undead you animated Duration 24 hours

You can cast this Spell only at night.

If a target is a Corpse, you animate it as a Skeleton Companion if it is just bones, or a Zombie Companion otherwise.

If a target is an Undead you animated, it becomes your Companion.

After this Spell ends, each target stops being your Companion but remains animated.

docs.title: Command Undead
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can command any of your Undead companions within 60 feet to move and take any Action available to them. You give the same command to each target.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 2 targets per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Animate Objects
docs.text:
3rd-Level Transmutation

Classes Artificer Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range 120 ft. Area — Target Up to 3 Huge or smaller Objects that aren't worn or carried Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

A Large Object counts as 2 of your targets, and a Huge Object counts as 3.

You animate each target as an Animated Object Companion. After a target drops to 0 Hit Points, this Spell ends on it.

docs.title: Command Constructs

docs.text:

Classes Wizard Components V, S Casting Time 1 minute, or Ritual Range 30 ft. Area — Target — Duration 1 hour

You conjure a horselike Phantom Steed Companion, equipped with a saddle, bit, and bridle. Any of this equipment vanishes if it is more than 10 feet from the steed.

After the steed takes any damage, this Spell ends. After this Spell ends, the steed fades over 1 minute, giving its rider time to dismount.

docs.title: Plant Growth
docs.text:
3rd-Level Transmutation

Classes Bard, Druid, Ranger Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action, or 8 hours Range 150 ft. Area Special Target — Duration 1 year

If you cast this Spell with its full Casting Time, choose a ½-mile radius Sphere. All plants in the area yield twice the food.

Otherwise, choose a 100-foot radius Sphere. You can exclude any part of the area. All normal plants in the area become thick and overgrown, and the area gains the following effects:

  • The area is Heavily Obscured.
  • Each foot of movement in the area costs 3 extra feet.

docs.title: Protection from Energy
docs.text:
3rd-Level Abjuration

Classes Artificer, Cleric, Druid, Ranger, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range Reach Area — Target 1 Creature or Object Duration 1 hour (Concentration)

Choose an Elemental Damage Type.

Each target gains Resistance to the chosen Damage Type.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Remove Curse
docs.text:
3rd-Level Abjuration

Classes Artificer, Cleric, Paladin, Warlock, Wizard Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range Reach Area — Target 1 Creature or Object Duration —

You end 1 curse on each target.

If a target is a Cursed Magic Item, it remains Cursed, but its Attunement with any Creatures ends.

docs.title: Revivify
docs.text:
3rd-Level Necromancy

Classes Artificer, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger Components V, S, M (consumes a diamond worth 300 Gold) Casting Time Magic Action Range Reach Area — Target 1 Corpse that died within the past minute Duration —

You resurrect each target with 1 Hit Point, and it gains 1 level of Exhaustion.

This Spell closes mortal wounds, but doesn't restore missing body parts or reverse the effects of old age; it has no effect on a target that can't sustain life.

docs.title: Scorching Stride
docs.text:
3rd-Level Transmutation

Classes Artificer, Ranger, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S Casting Time Bonus Action Range — Area — Target Self Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

Your Speed increases by 20 feet, and your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

After you move within 5 feet of a Creature or an Object that isn't being worn or carried, you deal 1d6 Fire Damage to it. A Creature or Object can take this damage only once per Turn.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 5 feet of Speed and 1d6 damage per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Secret Chest
docs.text:
3rd-Level Conjuration

Classes Artificer, Wizard Components V, S, M (a chest worth 5,000 Gold and a Tiny replica worth 50 Gold) Casting Time Magic Action Range Reach Area — Target The Chest used as a Material Component Duration Until dispelled

You teleport the target and its contents to the Ethereal Plane.

After the replica is destroyed, this Spell ends. After you cast this Spell again, the previous casting ends. After 60 days, each day has a cumulative 5% chance of ending this Spell.

docs.title: Recall
docs.text: Magic Action: While holding the replica, you can recall the target, which appears on the ground within 5 feet of you.

docs.title: Send Back
docs.text: Magic Action: While holding the replica and the target, you can send the target back to the Ethereal Plane.

docs.title: Sending
docs.text:
3rd-Level Divination

Classes Artificer, Bard, Cleric, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range Unlimited Area — Target 1 Creature you have seen Duration —

If the target is on a different Plane, there is a 5% chance this Spell has no effect.

You speak a short message.

Each target hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can respond in the same way or block you from targeting it with this Spell again for 8 hours.

docs.title: Silver Lance

3rd-Level Evocation

Classes Cleric, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S, M (a silver pin worth 250 Gold) Casting Time Magic Action Range Reach Area A 120-ft. × 5-ft. Line Target Each Creature and Object you choose Duration —

Each target makes a Fortitude Save.

Fail You deal 3d10 Force Damage, and you knock the target Prone. Success You deal half as much damage.

docs.text: Add 1d10 damage per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Silver Viper
docs.text:
3rd-Level Conjuration

Classes Druid, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Bonus Action Range — Area — Target Self Duration 1 hour

You gain 15 Temporary Hit Points and a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. After you lose your last Temporary Hit Point, this Spell ends.

docs.title: Viper Strike
docs.text:
Magic Action: You can make a Ranged Spell Attack against a Creature or Object within 60 feet.

Hit You deal 1d6 Poison Damage, and you sicken the target until the end of your next Turn. While Sickened by this Spell, a target is Incapacitated.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 5 Temporary Hit Points and 1d6 damage per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Sleet Storm
docs.text:
3rd-Level Conjuration

Classes Druid, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 150 ft. Area A 40-ft. radius, 20-ft. Cylinder, from above Target Each other Creature Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

The area is Heavily Obscured, exposed flames in it are doused, and the ground in the area is Difficult Terrain.

After a target enters the area (including when this Spell is cast), it makes a Reflex Save. After your Turn starts, each target also makes this Saving Throw. A target only makes this Saving Throw once until the start of your next Turn.

Fail You knock the target Prone, and it loses Concentration. Success No effect.

docs.title: Slow
docs.text:
3rd-Level Transmutation

Classes Artificer, Bard, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 120 ft. Area — Target Up to 6 Creatures Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

Each target makes a Will Save.

Fail The target gains the following effects:
  • You daze the target.
  • Its Speed becomes halved.
  • Its Armor Class decreases by 2, and its Reflex Saves decrease by 2.
  • If it Attacks, it can make only 1 attack.
  • A Spell it casts with a Somatic Component has a 25% chance to have no effect.
Success No effect.

Before a target's Turn ends, it repeats this Saving Throw.

Fail No additional effect. Success This Spell ends on the target.

docs.title: Speak with Dead
docs.text:
3rd-Level Necromancy

Classes Bard, Cleric, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 10 ft. Area — Target 1 Corpse with a mouth Duration 10 minutes

You can ask each target up to 5 questions. A target can speak, knows only what it knew in life, and isn't compelled to answer truthfully. Its soul isn't returned to its body, and it can't learn new information, comprehend anything that happened since it died, or speculate about the future.

docs.title: Speak with Plants
docs.text:
3rd-Level Transmutation

Classes Bard, Druid, Ranger Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range — Area A 30-ft. Aura Target Each Plant Creature and Plant Object Duration 10 minutes

Each target can understand any language you speak, and you can understand the target as though it could speak.

Each target answers your questions to the best of its ability. At a minimum, it can tell you about nearby events it sensed within the past day.

docs.title: Spirit Guardians
docs.text:
3rd-Level Conjuration

Classes Cleric Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range — Area A 15-ft. Aura Target Each Creature and Object you choose Duration 10 minutes (Concentration)

Choose Radiant or Necrotic.

Each target's Speed becomes halved while in the area.

After a target enters the area (including when this Spell is cast or the area moves), it makes a Will Save. After your Turn starts, each target also makes this Saving Throw. A target only makes this Saving Throw once until the start of your next Turn.

Fail You deal 3d8 damage of the chosen type. Success You deal half as much damage.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1d8 damage per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Spirit Shroud
docs.text:
3rd-Level Necromancy

Classes Cleric, Paladin, Warlock, Wizard Components V, S Casting Time Bonus Action Range — Area A 10-ft. Aura Target Each Creature and Object you choose Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

Choose Radiant, Necrotic, or Cold Damage.

Before you deal damage to a target with an Attack, you can add 1d8 damage of the chosen type.

After a target starts its Turn in the area, its Speed decreases by 10 feet until the start of its next Turn.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1d8 damage per additional Spell Level.

docs.text:

Classes Paladin Components V Casting Time Bonus Action, after you hit with a Melee Weapon Attack Range — Area — Target The target of the triggering Attack Duration —

You add 4d6 Psychic Damage to the triggering Attack.

After the Attack, the target makes a Will Save.

Fail You sicken the target until the end of its Turn. While Sickened by this Spell, a target is Dazed. Success No effect.

docs.text:
3rd-Level Transmutation

Classes Artificer, Cleric, Druid, Wizard Components V, S, M (soft clay) Casting Time Magic Action Range Reach Area A 5-ft. Cube Target — Duration —

You permanently transform any stone in the area into any shape you like, provided you have enough material. The new shape can have up to two hinges and a latch, but no finer mechanical detail.

Classes Ranger Components V, S Casting Time Bonus Action Range — Area — Target 1 Bow or Crossbow Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

The target conjures its own Ammunition and can deal Force Damage instead of its normal Damage Type. The Ammunition vanishes after the Attack.

You take the following Action as part of casting this Spell.

docs.title: Draw
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can make 2 Attacks using the target.

docs.title: Thunder Step
docs.text:
3rd-Level Conjuration

Classes Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard Components V Casting Time Magic Action Range 90 ft. Area — Target Self, and up to 1 Ally within Reach Duration —

You teleport. If this Spell has another target, it arrives in a space within 5 feet of your destination.

After you teleport, each Creature and Object within 10 feet of the space you left makes a Fortitude Save.

Fail You deal 3d10 Thunder Damage. Success You deal half as much damage.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1d10 damage per additional Spell Level.

docs.text:
3rd-Level Conjuration

Classes Druid, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 120 ft. Area A 30-ft. × 10-ft. Line Target Each Creature and Object Duration —

Exposed flames in the area and within 30 feet of it are doused.

Each target makes a Reflex Save.

Fail You deal 4d8 Bludgeoning Damage, propel the target up to 15 feet, and knock the target Prone. Success You deal half as much damage.

docs.title: Tiny Hut
docs.text:
3rd-Level Evocation

Classes Bard, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time 1 minute, or Ritual Range — Area A 10-ft. Aura Target — Duration 8 hours

You conjure a ¼-inch thick barrier of magical force around the area.

The barrier has the following effects:

Effect Semi-Visible The barrier is opaque from the outside (any color you choose), and translucent from the inside. Immovable The barrier is Anchored. Impervious The barrier has Immunity to all damage. Semi-Passable Everything inside the barrier when it appears can pass through it freely; nothing else can pass through it, including Attacks and other effects. Ward Targeting A lower-Level magical effect can't target anything in the area from outside the barrier. Ward Area The area is excluded from a lower-Level magical effect's area. Comfortable The area is comfortable and dry regardless of the weather outside. Dimmable You can change the area's lighting from Bright Light, Dim Light, or Darkness (no Action required).

Before the barrier appears, you propel each Creature and Object in the barrier's space to either side of it.

After you leave the area, this Spell ends. After you cast this Spell again, the previous casting ends.

docs.title: Tiny Servant
docs.text:

You animate each target as an Animated Servant Companion. After a target drops to 0 Hit Points, this Spell ends on it.

docs.title: Wall of Water
docs.text:
3rd-Level Evocation

Classes Druid, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 60 ft. Area A 30-ft. × 5-ft. × 10-ft. Wall, or a 10-ft.-radius, 20-ft. Cylinder Target — Duration 10 minutes (Concentration)

A creature must Swim to move through the area.

A Ranged Weapon Attack made through the area gains Disadvantage, and the area halves Fire Damage from an effect passing through it.

Cold Damage passing through the area freezes a 5-foot section of it solid. A frozen section has an Armor Class of 5 and 15 Hit Points; if it has 0 Hit Points, it is destroyed, leaving a gap the water doesn't fill.

docs.text:

Small or smaller flying creatures and objects can't pass through the area, nor can a creature in Gaseous Form. Ordinary projectiles launched through the area automatically miss, though boulders and siege-engine projectiles are unaffected.

After a target enters the area (including when this Spell is cast), it makes a Fortitude Save. After your Turn starts, each target also makes this Saving Throw. A target only makes this Saving Throw once until the start of your next Turn.

Fail You deal 4d8 Bludgeoning Damage. Success You deal half as much damage.

Each target can breathe underwater.

docs.text: Bonus Action: Any target can pass through a liquid's surface, entering or leaving the liquid.

docs.text: Bonus Action: You can move the sensor up to 30 feet in any direction. A solid barrier blocks it, but it can pass through an opening as small as 1 inch across.

docs.title: Banishment
docs.text:
4th-Level Abjuration

Classes Cleric, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 30 ft. Area — Target 1 Creature or Object Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

Each target makes a Will Save.

Fail You teleport the target to a harmless demiplane and incapacitate it.After this Spell ends, the target returns to the space it left, or the nearest unoccupied space. Success No effect.

docs.title: Permanence
docs.text:
If this Spell lasts the full duration, a teleported Planar Creature doesn't return.

If the Planar Creature is not on its home plane, you teleport it there instead.

Otherwise, you teleport it to a plane associated with its Planar Creature Type.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Black Tentacles
docs.text:
4th-Level Conjuration

Classes Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 90 ft. Area A 20-ft. Square Target Each Creature and Object Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

The area is Difficult Terrain.

After a target enters the area (including when this Spell is cast), it makes a Fortitude Save. After your Turn starts, each target also makes this Saving Throw. A target only makes this Saving Throw once until the start of your next Turn.

Fail You deal 3d6 Bludgeoning Damage and restrain the target. Success No effect.

docs.title: Escape
docs.text:
Utilize Action: Any Restrained target can make an Athletics Check against your Spell Save DC.

Success This effect ends on the target. Fail No effect.

docs.title: Blight
docs.text:
4th-Level Necromancy

Classes Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range 30 ft. Area — Target 1 Creature, or 1 Plant Object Duration —

If a target is a Plant Object, you kill it.

Any other target makes a Fortitude Save. If a target is a Plant Creature, it automatically fails.

Fail You deal 8d8 Necrotic Damage. Success You deal half as much damage.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1d8 damage per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Charm Monster
docs.text:
4th-Level Enchantment

Classes Bard, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range 30 ft. Area — Target 1 Creature Duration 1 hour

Each target makes a Will Save. An Enemy gains Advantage on the Saving Throw.

Fail You charm the target until you or an Ally damage it. While Charmed by this Spell, a target becomes an Ally. Success No effect.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Compulsion
docs.text:
4th-Level Enchantment

Classes Bard Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range — Area A 30-ft. Aura Target Each Creature you choose Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

Each target makes a Will Save.

Fail You charm the target. Success No effect.

docs.title: Command
docs.text:
Bonus Action: You can choose a direction. After a Charmed target's next Turn starts, it moves as far as it can in that direction by the safest route. Then, it makes a Will Save.

Fail No additional effect. Success This Spell ends on the target.

docs.title: Confusion
docs.text:
4th-Level Enchantment

Classes Bard, Druid, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 90 ft. Area A 10-ft. radius Sphere Target Each Creature Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

Each target makes a Will Save.

Fail The target can't take Bonus Actions or Reactions. Success No effect.

After an affected target's Turn starts, it rolls 1d10 to determine its behavior for that Turn:

1d10 1 The target takes no Action and uses all its movement to move in a random direction. Roll 1d4: 1 north, 2 east, 3 south, or 4 west. 2–6 The target takes no Action and doesn't move. 7–8 The target attacks 1 random creature within Reach. If none is within Reach, it takes no Action. 9–10 The target chooses its behavior.

Before a target's Turn ends, it repeats this Saving Throw.

Fail No additional effect. Success This Spell ends on the target.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 5 feet to the area's radius per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Conjure Minor Elementals
docs.text:
4th-Level Conjuration

Classes Druid, Wizard Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range — Area A 15-ft. Aura Target Each Creature and Object you choose Duration 10 minutes (Concentration)

Each target's Speed becomes halved while in the area.

Before you deal damage to a target with an Attack, you can add 2d8 Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning Damage.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 2d8 damage per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Conjure Woodland Beings
docs.text:
4th-Level Conjuration

Classes Druid Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range — Area A 10-ft. Aura Target Each Creature and Object you choose Duration 10 minutes (Concentration)

After a target enters the area (including when this Spell is cast or the area moves), it makes a Will Save. After your Turn starts, each target also makes this Saving Throw. A target only makes this Saving Throw once until the start of your next Turn.

Fail You deal 5d8 Force Damage. Success You deal half as much damage.

docs.title: Disengage
docs.text: Bonus Action: You can Disengage.

docs.title: At Higher Levels

docs.title: Control Water
docs.text:
4th-Level Transmutation

Classes Cleric, Druid, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 300 ft. Area Up to a 100-ft. Cube Target Each Creature and Object Duration 10 minutes (Concentration)

You control water in the area, choosing 1 of the following effects:

Effect Flood You raise the water level of all standing water in the area by up to 20 feet. In a large body of water, you instead transform the water into a 20-foot wave that crosses the area and crashes. A Huge or smaller vehicle in the wave's path is carried along; a Huge or smaller vehicle the wave strikes has a 25% chance of capsizing. After your Turn starts, the wave repeats until you choose another effect. Part Water You part the water in the area into a trench, the separated water forming a wall to either side. After you end this effect, the water fills the trench over the next Round. Redirect Flow You cause flowing water in the area to move in a direction you choose, even over obstacles or up walls. Beyond the area, it resumes its natural flow. Whirlpool The water in the area must be at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep to use this effect. You transform the water in a 25-ft. radius, 50-ft. Cylinder into a whirlpool.You immobilize each target in the whirlpool.After you transform the water and after your Turn starts, you propel each target within 25 feet of the whirlpool 10 feet toward its Origin.After a target enters the whirlpool (including when the water is transformed), it makes a Fortitude Save. After your Turn starts, each target in the whirlpool also makes this Saving Throw. A target only makes this Saving Throw once until the start of your next Turn.Fail. You deal 4d8 Bludgeoning Damage and the target can't hold its breath until the start of your next Turn.Success. You deal half as much damage.

docs.title: Swim Free
docs.text:
Utilize Action: Any Immobilized target can make an Athletics Check against your Spell Save DC.

Success The target ignores the whirlpool's movement penalties until the end of the Turn. Fail No effect.

docs.title: Change Effect
docs.text: Magic Action: You can change this Spell's chosen effect.

docs.title: Death Ward
docs.text:
4th-Level Abjuration

Classes Cleric Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range Reach Area — Target 1 Creature Duration 8 hours

Before a target would drop to 0 Hit Points or be killed, it instead survives with 1 Hit Point, then this Spell ends on that target.

docs.title: Dimension Door
docs.text:
4th-Level Conjuration

Classes Bard, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard Components V Casting Time Magic Action Range 500 ft. Area — Target Self, and up to 1 Ally within Reach Duration —

Choose 1 of the following effects:

Effect Describe You teleport to a space you describe by its distance and direction, ignoring Line of Effect. If any target would arrive in an occupied or blocked space, you deal 4d6 Force Damage to each target and the teleportation fails. See You teleport to a space you can see.

If this Spell has another target, it arrives in a space within 5 feet of your destination.

docs.title: Dominate Beast
docs.text:
4th-Level Enchantment

Classes Druid, Sorcerer Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range 60 ft. Area — Target 1 Beast Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

Each target makes a Will Save. An Enemy gains Advantage on the Saving Throw.

Fail You charm the target and it becomes a Companion to you. Success No effect.

After a Charmed target takes damage, it repeats this Saving Throw.

Fail No additional effect. Success This Spell ends on the target.

docs.title: Command
docs.text: Free Action: You can command a Charmed target to move and take any Action available to it.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text:
When Upcast to 5th-Level, the duration becomes 10 minutes.

When Upcast to 6th-Level, the duration becomes 1 hour.

When Upcast to 7th-Level or higher, the duration becomes 8 hours.

docs.title: Faithful Hound
docs.text:
4th-Level Conjuration

Classes Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 30 ft. Area A 30-ft. radius Sphere Target Each Small or larger Creature Duration 8 hours

You conjure a phantom hound in the area. Only you can perceive the hound. After you and the area become more than 300 feet apart, this Spell ends.

After a target enters the area, the hound emits the sound of barking out to 60 feet for 10 seconds.

After your Turn starts, up to 1 target you choose makes a Reflex Save.

Fail You deal 4d8 Force Damage and the hound can grapple the target (Escape DC Spell Save DC). The hound can only grapple 1 target at a time. Success No effect.

docs.title: Move
docs.text: Magic Action: You can move the area up to 30 feet.

docs.title: Password
docs.text: After you cast this Spell, you can choose a password. After a creature speaks this password, or presents it visually, the creature ignores this Spell's effects.

Classes Druid, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range — Area — Target Self Duration 10 minutes

Choose 1 of the following shields:

Shield Resistance Damage Type Warm Cold Fire Chill Fire Cold

You gain the chosen Resistance, and emit Bright Light out to 10 feet and Dim Light 10 feet further.

After a Creature within 5 feet hits you with a Melee Attack, you deal 2d8 damage of the chosen Damage Type to the attacker.

docs.text: Add 2d8 damage per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Fount of Moonlight

4th-Level Evocation

You emit Bright Light out to 20 feet and Dim Light 20 feet further.

You gain Radiant Resistance.

Your Melee Attacks deal an additional 2d6 Radiant Damage.

Fail You blind the target until the end of your next Turn. Success No effect.

4th-Level Abjuration

Each target gains the following effects:

  • It ignores Difficult Terrain.
  • Magical effects can't reduce its Speeds, paralyze it, or restrain it.
  • It gains a Swim Speed equal to its Speed.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 target per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Grasping Vine
docs.text:
4th-Level Conjuration

Classes Druid Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range 60 ft. Area — Target — Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

You conjure a vine. The vine is a Large Plant Object with Immunity to all damage.

You take the following Action as part of casting this Spell.

docs.title: Lash
docs.text:
Bonus Action: You can release any of the vine's grappled targets. Then, you can make a Melee Spell Attack against 1 Creature or Object within 30 feet of the vine.

Hit You deal 4d8 + Spellcasting Ability Bludgeoning Damage and propel the target up to 30 feet toward the vine. If the target is Huge or smaller, the vine can grapple it (Escape DC Spell Save DC). While Grappled by the vine, a target is Restrained. The vine can only grapple 1 target at a time.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 1 creature the vine can grapple per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Hallucinatory Terrain
docs.text:
4th-Level Illusion

Classes Bard, Druid, Warlock, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time 10 minutes Range 300 ft. Area Up to a 150-ft. Cube Target — Duration 24 hours

You conjure an illusion that makes the natural terrain in the area look, sound, and smell like another kind of natural terrain. The area's physical characteristics are unchanged, and manufactured structures, objects, and creatures in the area are unaffected.

docs.title: Search
docs.text:
A creature whose Passive Perception exceeds your Spell Save DC knows the illusion is false.

Search Action: Any creature that perceives the illusion can make a Perception Check against your Spell Save DC.

Success The creature knows the illusion is false and ignores its effects. Fail No effect.

docs.title: Polymorph
docs.text:
4th-Level Transmutation

Classes Bard, Druid, Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 60 ft. Area — Target 1 Creature Duration 1 hour (Concentration)

Each target makes a Will Save.

Fail Choose any Beast with a Level no higher than the target's. The target gains the following effects:
  • The target's game statistics are replaced by the Beast's, but it keeps its alignment, personality, Creature Type, Hit Points, and Hit Dice.
  • The target gains the Beast's Maximum Hit Points Temporary Hit Points.
  • The target can't speak or cast Spells, and can act only as its new form's anatomy allows.
  • The target's gear melds into the new form and can't be used.
Success No effect.

After a target loses its last Temporary Hit Point, this Spell ends on it.

docs.title: Private Sanctum
docs.text:
4th-Level Abjuration

Classes Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time 10 minutes Range 120 ft. Area Up to a 100-ft. Cube Target — Duration 24 hours

The area gains any number of the following effects:

Effect Obscured The area is Heavily Obscured from the outside. Ward Divination Creatures in the area can't be targeted by Divination Spells. Ward Scrying A Scrying Sensor can't enter the area. Ward Sound No sound can pass into or out of the area. Ward Travel Nothing can enter or leave the area by teleportation or Planar Travel.

docs.text: If you cast this Spell on the same area every day for 365 days, the effect lasts until dispelled.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 100 feet to the area's maximum size per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Resilient Sphere
docs.text:
4th-Level Abjuration

Classes Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 30 ft. Area A 5-ft. radius Sphere Target — Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

You conjure a ¼-inch thick barrier of magical force around the area.

The barrier has the following effects:

Effect Invisible The barrier is Invisible. Impervious The barrier has Immunity to all damage. Impassable Nothing can pass through the barrier, including Attacks and other effects. Ward Targeting A lower-Level magical effect can't target anything in the area from outside the barrier. Ward Area The area is excluded from a lower-Level magical effect's area.

Before the barrier appears, you propel each Creature and Object in the barrier's space to either side of it. Then, each target in the area makes a Reflex Save. If a target is Huge or larger, it automatically succeeds.

Fail No effect. Success The target can move up to half its Speed.

docs.title: Roll Sphere
docs.text: Utilize Action: Any creature in the area can move the area, and everything in it, up to half the creature's Speed.

After a target enters the area or within 10 feet of the chosen side (including when this Spell is cast), it makes a Reflex Save. After your Turn starts, each target in the area and within 10 feet of the chosen side also makes this Saving Throw. A target only makes this Saving Throw once until the start of your next Turn.

5th-Level Abjuration

Classes Druid Components V, S Casting Time Magic Action Range — Area A 10-ft. Aura Target Each Creature that isn't a Construct or Undead Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

You propel each target in the area to the nearest unoccupied space outside it. A target can't enter the area or reach into it (Spells, Ranged Attacks, and Reach Weapons still pass through). After you move so that a blocked creature would be forced into the area, this Spell ends.

docs.title: Arcane Hand
docs.text:
5th-Level Evocation

Classes Sorcerer, Wizard Components V, S, M Casting Time Magic Action Range 120 ft. Area — Target — Duration 1 minute (Concentration)

You conjure a hand of magical energy. The hand is a Large, intangible Object with Armor Class 20 and your Hit Point Maximum Hit Points. After the hand drops to 0 Hit Points, this Spell ends.

You take the following Action as part of casting this Spell.

docs.title: Command
docs.text:
Bonus Action: You can move the hand up to 60 feet, then choose 1 of the following effects:

Effect Clenched Fist You make a Melee Spell Attack against a Creature or Object within 5 feet of the hand; on a hit, you deal 5d8 + Spellcasting Ability Force Damage. Pushing Hand A Huge or smaller Creature or Object within 5 feet of the hand makes a Fortitude Save; on a failure, you propel the target 5 × (Spellcasting Ability + 1) feet away from the hand, and the hand moves with it. Grappling Hand A Huge or smaller Creature or Object within 5 feet of the hand makes a Reflex Save; on a failure, the hand grapples the target (DC Spell Save DC). While Grappled by the hand, a target is Restrained. The hand can only grapple 1 target at a time. Crushing Hand While the hand is grappling, you can deal 4d6 + Spellcasting Ability Bludgeoning Damage to the Grappled target. Covering Hand The hand counts as Half Cover for you against Attacks and effects, and its space is Difficult Terrain for your Enemies.

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: Add 2d8 to the Clenched Fist damage and 2d6 to the Crushing Hand damage per additional Spell Level.

docs.title: Awaken
docs.text:

If a target is a Plant Object, you animate it as a Plant Creature, using statistics the DM chooses.

Each target's Intelligence becomes 0, and it learns to speak and understand one language you know.

You charm each target for 30 days, or until you or an Ally deals damage to it. After the Charm ends, it chooses its Disposition toward you.

After a target enters the area (including when this Spell is cast or the area moves), it makes a Fortitude Save. After your Turn starts, each target also makes this Saving Throw. A target only makes this Saving Throw once until the start of your next Turn.

The area gains 1 of the following effects:

Effect Courage Each target gains Fear Immunity. Darkness The area gains the effect of Darkness. Fear While a sealed creature is in the area, the area frightens it. Gentle Repose Corpse targets gain the effect of Gentle Repose. Resistance Choose any Damage Type. Each target gains Resistance to the chosen Damage Type. Sunlight Bright Sunlight fills the area. Tongues Each target gains the effect of Tongues. Vulnerability A sealed creature gains Vulnerability to damage that originates from the area. Ward Sound No sound can pass into or out of the area. Ward Travel Nothing can enter or leave the area by teleportation or Planar Travel.

docs.text: If you cast this Spell on the same area every day for 365 days, the effect lasts until dispelled.

Fail You charm and incapacitate the target, and it is unaware of its surroundings, except it can still hear you.While the target is Charmed, you can verbally change its memory of one event it experienced within the past 24 hours and that lasted no more than 10 minutes. If the target can understand you, you can erase the event, restore it with perfect clarity, alter its details, or replace it with a memory of another event. Success No effect.

After a target takes damage or is targeted by another Spell, this Spell ends on it.

docs.title: Permanence
docs.text: If this Spell lasts the full duration, the memory takes hold and the effect lasts until dispelled (no Concentration required).

docs.title: At Higher Levels
docs.text: When Upcast, you can alter the target's memory of an event up to 7 days ago (6th-Level), 30 days ago (7th-Level), 365 days ago (8th-Level), or any time in its past (9th-Level).

You conjure a passage through a surface, up to 5 feet wide, 8 feet tall, and 20 feet deep. The passage creates no instability in the surrounding structure.

You resurrect each target with 1 Hit Point and end each Sickness on it. The target's Exhaustion level becomes 5.

Physical Connection Save Modifier None +0 A picture or likeness of the target −2 A garment or possession of the target −4 A body part, lock of hair, or nail clipping of the target −10 Fail You conjure a Scrying Sensor within 10 feet of the target, and can see and hear through it. If the target is a creature, the sensor moves to stay within 10 feet of the target. Success You can't target the target with this Spell for 24 hours.

docs.title: Scrying Sensors
docs.text: A Scrying Sensor is a Tiny, floating eye that you can perceive through. It is Invisible and intangible, and has 30 feet of Darkvision. While you perceive through a Scrying Sensor, your own senses are unaffected.

The first time you learn or prepare Teleportation Circle, you learn 2 sigils. If you encounter additional sigils, you can learn them by spending 1 minute studying.
